Biologi, kalastaja ja tutkimusmatkailija Jeremy Wade matkustaa ympäri maailmaa tutkimaan vesistöjä ja vesielämää. programme.desc: Lazy River Runs Through It. Pihasuunnittelija Lucas Congdon ja hänen tiiminsä rakentavat uskomattomia uima-altaita. programme.desc: The local creek is polluted and pesticide run-off is to blame. Francine is determined to get the word out at the annual Earth Day rally. Ladonna can't wait to experience her first blizzard, if only the weather would cooperate.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur and The Real Mr. Ratburn/Arthur's Spelling Trubble
programme.desc: It's the first day of third grade and Arthur's biggest fear has come true--his new teacher is the dreaded Mr. Ratburn. Then, it’s time for the all-school spellathon. Arthur is chosen to compete, and he finds facing Prunella and The Brain!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: To Tibble the Truth/Waiting to Go
programme.desc: When the Tibble Twins' constant lying lands them in constant trouble, they promise to tell only the truth. Binky and Brain collide on the soccer field, breaking Brain's new watch and nearly breaking their friendship.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: No Acting Please/Prunella Deegan and the Disappointing Ending
programme.desc: When Fern lands a role in a community production, she fears she's not talented enough to be a star. Finally, the final volume of the Henry Screever series is out. Prunella and Marina compete to see who can finish the book the fastest.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Ants in Arthur's Pants/Don't Ask Muffy
programme.desc: To excel in science, the class has to prove that they have P.A.N.T.S.--the ability to be patient, attentive, nosy, thoughtful, and systematic. And Muffy starts an advice column to launch her career as a rich and famous talk-show host.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Dummy Disaster/Francine and The Feline
programme.desc: When painfully shy George brings a ventriloquist dummy to school, a popular kid is born! Then, Arthur thinks the best pet to have is a dog, and Francine probably would have agreed--that is, until little Nemo, a cute kitten, came along.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Blackout/Mei Lin Takes a Stand
programme.desc: It's a hot day in Elwood City, and a total blackout leaves its residents without electricity! Will Arthur and DW survive without AC and TV? Binky's baby sister Mei-Lin isn't keen on learning to walk and would rather stick to crawling.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: D.W. Beats All/Buster the Myth Maker
programme.desc: After the Tibbles get a set of drums to play at the music festival, D.W. is determined to get an even bigger and louder one. Then, Buster is always telling the most incredible stories, but now he claims there is a tiger in the state forest.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: An army of lice has descended on the heads of Lakewood Elementary. Who or what is strong enough to defeat them? What if you could be Arthur for a day? View Arthur's life through his very own eyes for this special episode.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Castles in the Sky/Tipping the Scales
programme.desc: The gang is devastated after their tree house collapses. Can architect Frank Gehry help them to rebuild? Everyone in Arthur's chorus group is excited about their upcoming performance in Crown City.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Fern and the Case of the Stolen Story/Sue Ellen Vegges Out
programme.desc: Fern has writer's block! Fortunately, Ladonna's full of stories, and Fern decides to "borrow" the tales and simply change the names. Then, when Sue Ellen decides to stop eating meat, Muffy and Francine compete to be the best vegetarian.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Tattletale Frog/D.W. & Bud's Higher Purpose
programme.desc: When Bud is blamed for an accident D.W. causes, she has to decide whether to let her friend take the fall. D.W. and Bud can't wait to ride a new rollercoaster. Will they make it past the ticket taker, or will they come up short?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: There's a new kid in town: Ladonna Compson, the Louisiana native with the gift of gab. Ladonna charms Arthur and friends with her amazing "true" stories. But are her stories really fact…or fiction?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Pea and the Princess/D.W. and Dr. Whosit
programme.desc: The 3rd grade class is putting on a production of “The Princess and the Pea,” and Prunella is at the helm as director! Then, Mom and Dad tell D.W. she’s too young to watch a new television show that everyone is talking about.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Background Blues/And Now Let's Talk To Some Kids
programme.desc: Wouldn't it be cool to find out that your ancestors were famous frontier explorers? But what if they were just...plain folks? The Magic Toolbox show is coming to Ratburn's class to put the kids on TV!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur vs. The Very Mean Crossing Guard/D.W.'s Very Bad Mood
programme.desc: Arthur and The Brain encounter a new crossing guard on the way home from school. This guard isn't just mean, he's nuts! And, D.W. is making Arthur's life miserable! Francine decides she'd fix D.W.'s behavior before Arthur loses his mind.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Rhyme For Your Life/For Whom The Bell Tolls
programme.desc: While struggling to write a poem for his mom, Binky falls asleep and gets trapped in Verseberg--where it's a crime not to rhyme! And D.W. has lost her voice! For Arthur it's a dream come true--until Mom asks Arthur to take care of D.W.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: When Carl Met George/D.W. Swims with the Fishes
programme.desc: George is excited about his new friend, Carl. Then George learns that Carl has Asperger's Syndrome – can they remain good friends? D.W. and James enter the pre-school swim meet and recruit their big siblings to coach them.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Mr. Ratburn decides it's time for his class to learn a little about money. For the entire weekend, no one in the class can spend a cent. Buster has the brand-new Dark Bunny Dark Buggy, complete with grappling hook and voice commands!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's the Elwood City dog show and Killer is facing off against Sebastian Winkleplotz, the snooty, championship-winning poodle. Arthur agrees to watch Amigo while Alberto's off at camp, but Pal gets worried.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Emily gets the starring role in the preschool play, D.W. is beside herself with jealousy. She should be Little Red Riding Hood, not Tree #2! Then, D.W. and Emily are upset when they get stuck with the blocks at playtime.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: D.W. Goes To Washington/Arthur's Mystery Envelope
programme.desc: D.W.'s on her way to Washington and she's bored by it all until she gets lost during a tour of the White House. Then, when Mr. Haney gives Arthur a sealed envelope to bring home to Mom, Arthur fears the worst.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster finds out that his collection of old food makes excellent compost--which makes for even better tomatoes! Then, neither of the Tibble twins has ever won the coveted "Good Behavior of the Week" cupcake award.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When the Athlete of the Year Award doesn't go to Francine, she makes no effort to hide her hurt feelings from the recipient. Arthur can't believe his parents are hiring a babysitter--he's 8 years old, and babysitters are b-o-r-i-n-g!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Chicken Pox/Sick As A Dog
programme.desc: The circus is in town and the whole family's excited—until Arthur gets CHICKEN POX! Will he recover in time? Then, Arthur's worst fears come true when poor, sick Pal has to sleep overnight at the vet's office. Could it be something he did?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buster's Book Battle/On the Buster Scale
programme.desc: Lakewood Elementary has just instituted IRP; a program where kids can earn points (and prizes!) for reading. Then, Buster and Brain never agree on movies. Buster rates every film a 10+, while Brain doesn't seem to like anything.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Curse of the Grebes/Arthur Changes Gears
programme.desc: The Elwood City Grebes haven't won the Baseball Championship since 1918. But with the addition of three players, the title is finally within reach. Arthur finally saves enough money to buy the bike of his dreams!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and Francine are fighting. But when they get locked inside the library they either have to make up or prepare for a long evening. And when Buster opens his detective agency, he has no idea his first job will involve Arthur.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's new puppy is exactly what he wanted. He's cute and wriggly, and he follows Arthur everywhere. But training a puppy is harder than Arthur thought. Then, a mere $10 stands between Arthur and the shoes he's been dreaming about.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Lakewood Elementary is sure to win the big bowling tournament on Saturday, but Francine's cousin is having his Bar Mitzvah at the same time! Muffy happily accepts an invitation to spend the weekend in the bustling Crown City.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Binky Barnes, Wingman/To Beat Or Not To Beat
programme.desc: Does Binky have a favorite pastime? Not until citywide Bug Week, when suddenly all he can think about is butterflies. Then, there's a horrible racket in Elwood City, and it's Francine practicing her singing and drumming for the Talent Show!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When shy George wonders if any of his friends notice him, he decides he won’t speak to anyone until they do! Fern volunteers to help an elderly neighbor with his household chores, and then discovers his past life as a Kung Fu celebrity.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Mysterious calls. Superhuman strength. Is Mr. Ratburn secretly a superhero? When Buster and Ladonna bond over a memorable trip to the movies, Arthur feels left out. Has Ladonna taken his place as Buster's best bud?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: My Music Rules/That's A Baby Show!
programme.desc: It's the duel of the century as cellist Yo-Yo Ma faces jazz saxophonist Joshua Redman in the toughest gig of their careers at the Elwood City Library! Then, will Arthur be exposed as a baby show lover?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: D.W. Tale Spins/Prunella Gets It Twice
programme.desc: What happens when you combine Greek Mythology with D.W.'s imagination? Then, getting two Polly Locket dolls almost ruins Prunella's birthday party. That, and Francine's bad mood--why, she wouldn't even sing the Happy Birthday song!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Blizzard/The Rat Who Came To Dinner
programme.desc: A blizzard comes to town, taking out the electricity and sending residents scrambling for supplies. Can neighbors find ways to help each other survive through the storm? Then, the unthinkable is happening...Arthur's teacher is moving in!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Tales of Grotesquely Grim Bunny/Pet Projects
programme.desc: When the comic book store changes owners, the new darker comics are right up Fern's alley, but Arthur can't seem to stomach them. Arthur and Francine enter their pets to compete against each other in the "Perfect Pet" video contest.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Alberto discovers he has a natural talent for golf and begins to compete, but will his dad's embarrassing cheers make him give it up? Buster has lost his flair for funny, and the harder he tries to make people laugh, the worse it gets.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Mister Rogers is staying at Arthur's house! Mister Rogers is a nice guy, but... his show is for babies! Can Arthur hide the visit from his friends? Next, the trouble starts when Fern draws a not-too-flattering cartoon of Francine.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Why is Buster walking backwards and Muffy not talking? They're trying to set world records of course! Then, Arthur thinks his class trip to the Clark Caves will be really cool--but won't it be dark in there?

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Ann an turas sgoinneil eile, tha Hari a' dol air tòir 'map'. Tha e a' lorg scutair agus frith-rathad fhad's a tha e ga lorg, ach am bi aige air 'map' fhaighinn agus faighinn a-mach dè tha e a' dèanamh? In another 'aba-doo-be-dee' adventure, Hari goes in search of a map. He comes across a scooter and a pathway as he explores the area, but will he be able to find out what a map looks like and what it does?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Teàrlach a’ faireachdainn tinn is chan eil e airson cluich. Tha Peicein agus a charaidean a’ feuchainn ri bruidhinn ris, tha iad a’ teagasg an cànan fhèin dha, is a’ feuchainn ri cainnt nan con ionnsachadh iad fhèin. Tadeo is feeling sick and doesn't want to play. Petit and his friends try to communicate with him, teaching Tadeo human language and trying to learn dog talk themselves.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ‘S e latha socair a th’ ann air an eilean, latha math airson a bhith dìomhain. Tha Àtaidh, Tilidh agus Nìp a’ crochadh hamag, is tha tòrr spòrs aca a’ feuchainn ri faighinn oirre. Tha na Boga-bogadaich a’ feuchainn ri faighinn oirre cuideachd, ach tha iad air an caith suas dhan adhar is a’ dol a-mach à sealladh. Càite an deach iad? Tha Àtaidh, Tilidh agus Nìp a’ falbh a’ lorg nam Boga-bogadach. It is a lazy day on the Island. Abney, Teal and Neep put up a hammock and have a great time trying to get into it. The Poc-Pocs join in the fun but are thrown up into the air and disappear. Where have they gone? Abney, Teal and Neep go on a Poc-Poc hunt.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Pompon a’ faireachdainn nach eil sìon a' dol ceart dha, tha Dadaidh a' sealltainn dòigh dha air rudan a chur ceart! When Pompon feels that nothing is going right for him, Dadaidh shows him a way to sort things out!

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Sionnach brònach nuair a chì e gun fheàrr le Maigheach a bhith a’ leughadh leabhar seach a bhith còmhla ris-san. Tha Tosg a’ moladh dhà e fhèin a chur ann an riochd ridire gaisgeil airson aire Maighich fhaighinn air ais. Tha an dithis aca a’ togail dràgon leis a’ bheachd gum faigh Sionnach buaidh air an dràgon, agus gun dearbh e a luach do Mhaigheach. When Hare would rather read her big book of fairytales than hang out with Fox, he fears he’s not exciting enough. According to Tusk, only by becoming a brave knight will Fox be able to prove the opposite is true. The two decide to build a dragon so Fox can beat it in battle and prove his worth to Hare.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Tha Mgr. Crùbag air a chlisgeadh mun sgrùdadh slàinte aige. Mr Krabs is too scared to get his physical.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Ged a tha na saor-làithean air tòiseachadh do sgoilearan Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, tha latha a bharrachd aig an luchd-teagaisg airson beagan trèanaidh. Tha an t-eòlaiche-inntinn Sìleas Stern os cionn sheiseanan gus sìth agus càirdeas a stèidheachadh am measg an luchd-obrach. Although the holidays have started for the pupils of Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche, the teachers have an in-service day. Mr Mackle is keen to establish better relationships between his staff and has invited psychologist Sìleas Stern to run team building sessions that he hopes will bring peace and harmony.

programme.title: Calum: Cogadh nan Comhlan
programme.desc: Tha Calum airson a chòmhlann aige a thoirt à Glaschu dhan Òban airson blàr mòr ciùil a tha dol aig a' Mhòd Nàiseanta Rìoghail. Ach, le tòrr fharpaisean agus gainead tìde, chan eil cùisean a' dol mar bu chòir. Leis nach eil e furasda còmhlan a làimhseachadh aig na h-amannan as fheàrr, saoil ciamar a thèid dhaibh leis na dùbhlain mhòra a th' air thoiseach orra... Calum aims to take his band from Glasgow to Oban for a major musical battle at the Royal National Mòd. However, with numerous competitions and time constraints, things aren't going according to plan. Managing a band is never easy even in the best of times - how will they cope with the significant challenges that lie ahead?

programme.title: Oidhche Shamhna CBBC ALBA
programme.desc: Tanith Rothach le taghadh a tha eagalach fhèin math airson Oidhche Shamhna, le slaidhm, braimeannan agus taibhse no dhà cuideachd! Tanith Munro introduces some frighteningly good highlights for Halloween, with slime, farts and a ghost or two!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke are at home, stocking their cupboards with acorn flour, hedgehog mushrooms, juniper berries and angelica seeds for the winter.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s-1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Angus Mackay is joined by close friend Finlay Macleod from Scalpay for the final fishing trip of the season. With summer fading, the environment looks very different as the purple heather really comes to the fore. Tracked by the golden eagle, they sail north to the hamlet of Calbost to take advantage of the shelter offered by its bay on a less than optimal day. As the duo fish in the bay, they ponder the extremes of the sea - its matchless beauty and its mortal danger. Anns a’ phrògram mu dheireadh san t-sreath, tha Fionnlagh MacLeòid à Sgalpaigh, còmhla ri Aonghas airson an turas iasgaich mu dheireadh den t-seusan. Leis an samhradh a’ tighinn gu crìoch, tha an àrainneachd a’ coimhead gu math eadar-dhealaichte, ‘s am fraoch purpaidh a’ tighinn am follais. Air an leantainn le iolaire-bhuidhe, seòlaidh iad gu tuath, gu Calbost gus beagan fasgadh fhaighinn sa bhàgh, air latha meadhanach grod. Fhad ’s a tha iad ag iasgach, tha iad a’ meòrachadh air an dà chuid cunnart agus bòidhchead na mara.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Highlights and previously unseen performances, featuring Mairi McGillivary, Ciaran Ryan and Fara. Roghainn fon sreath ciùil comhla ri Màiri Nicillebhrath, Ciaran Ryan and Fara.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee, with guest Calum Alex MacMillan. Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Calum Ailig MacMhaolain. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Gàrraidhean Mòra na h-Alba
programme.desc: Murdo Macdonald explores Ardkinglas Gardens in Argyll. Murchadh Dòmhnallach a’cur eòlas air Gàrradh Àird Chonghlais ann an Earra-Ghaidheal.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: The vast landscape of the Cairngorms attracts thousands each year. Coinneach Rankin sets out on a multi-day expedition to learn why its vast mountains are a paradise for climbers, runners and so many others. Along with his partner, Coinneach races up one of the highest mountains in Scotland, undertakes a classic multi-pitch climb, and spends the night in a tiny bothy built in the 1960s. Tàlaidh cruth-tìre aibheiseach a’ Mhonaidh Ruaidh na mìltean gach bliadhna. Cuiridh Coinneach MacFhraing aghaidh air turas grunn làithean gus tuigsinn carson a tha sreapadairean, luchd-coise agus eile cho measail air na beanntan seo. An cuideachd deagh charaid, thèid Coinneach na dheann suas tè de na beanntan as àirde an Alba, dìreidh e slighe-sreapa fhada agus cuiridh e seachad na h-oidhche ann am bothan a thogadh ‘sna seasgadan. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets Ian Smith in the village he was brought up, before they head along one of Tiree’s most famous beaches. As they walk along the coast, Ian reflects on his youth and the people that impacted him. Ian discusses how the Tiree music scene shaped him and brought him success as a box player, and he shares his passion for the island and his pride in setting up the only distillery in Tiree. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Coinnichidh Ramsay ri Iain Mac a’ Ghobhainn sa bhaile san d’rugadh e mas dèan iad air tè de na tràighean as iomraitiche ann an Tiriodh. Meòirichidh Iain air làithean òige agus na daoine bu mhotha a thug buaidh air a bheatha. Leis cho cudromach ‘s a tha ceòl air eilean Thiriodh, innsidh Iain man bhuaidh a bh’aige seo air fhèin agus mar a chuidich e a bhith cho soirbheachail le cluich a’ bhogsa. Bidh an dà chuid a mheas air an eilean agus a mhoit man aon taigh-stàile san eilean fhaighinn stèidhichte follaiseach. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ceol Sith
programme.desc: Come on a thrilling journey into the world of fairies and folklore with Ingrid Henderson. Thigibh air turas a-steach gu saoghal shìthichean agus creutairean os-nadarra eile le Ingrid NicEunraig.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: In 2019, a catastrophic fire threatened Notre-Dame’s structure. Analysing the vaults of the building, researchers unveil its history and decipher the secrets of its past resistance.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: 'S e th' ann am Brot fìor bhlast' de Choiridh leantail, ach lòn sònraicht' nach dìochuimhnich thu ann an cabhaig. An extremely delicious curried lentil soup is a special lunch which you won't forget in a hurry. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: An Geam Àlainn
programme.desc: Ball-coise nam ban ann an Alba bho shealladh luchd-cluiche, luchd-leantainn & eòlaichean. Women’s football in Scotland seen through the eyes of players, fans and experts.

programme.title: Na Trads
programme.desc: Na Trads: An Dara Teud. Roghainn bho oidhche mhòr duaisean Na Trads 2023, a tighinn à Talla Caird, Dùn Dè. Le Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Alistair Heather air an àrd-ùrlar agus air cùl stèids, coinneachaidh sin ris na luchd-ciùil agus na rionnagan a shoirbhich air an oidhche. Am measg na bhios a’ gabhail pàirt bidh Peatbog Faeries, Mànran, Joy Dunlop, Karine Polwart & Dave Milligan, Amy Laurenson, SC & T Youth agus an Robbie Shepherd Tribute. Highlights and music from the Trad Awards, from the Caird Hall, Dundee. Presenters Mary Ann Kennedy and Alistair Heather host the evening and we catch up with winners and stars of the event, both onstage and behind the scenes. Performances from Peatbog Faeries, Mànran, Joy Dunlop, Karine Polwart & Dave Milligan, Amy Laurenson, SC & T Youth and a musical tribute to a national treasure - the late Robbie Shepherd.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Le taic bho chàch, tha Pipp a’ dol na banrigh, le crùn, cathair agus parèid rìoghail. With a bit of Froggie help, Pipp turns into a queen with crown, throne and royal parade.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Meanbh is Beag ag adhbharachadh tubaist a tha a’ gabhail a-steach dìtheanan bulgach, am Moo-adhair, agus a’ Chearc Iarainn. Ciamar a thèid cùisean a cheartachadh? Meanbh and Beag cause an accident which involves bubble flowers, the Sky-Moo and the Iron Chicken. How will they get things sorted?

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Beag tro chèile oir cha d' fhuair e air na solais iongantach fhaicinn nuair a bha e a-muigh ’g iasgach san long-chiùil. Dè nì Am Màidsear airson togail a thoirt do Bheag? Beag is upset when he misses seeing two spectacular lights whilst out fishing in the music boat. What will Am Màidsear do to cheer Small up?

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Baba a' coinneachadh ri a charaid, Spiky, ach, chan eil Spiky airson cluich an-diugh - tha e troimh chèile 's e air a mhàthair a chall. Tha Baba cur roimhe Spiky a chuideachadh 's tha an dithis aca a' togail orra air turas-dàna! Baba is excited to meet his new friend Spiky, but Spiky doesn't want to play today as he has lost his mother and is very upset. Baba is determined to help and so the pair set off on an adventure to find her!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Oona 's Silky a' cur romhpa snàmh cuide ri na leumadairean ach tha Silky bochd a' tighinn an aghaidh creutair neònach a tha a' cur an dearg eagal orra! Tha an dithis a' dol gu Bernie gus faighinn a-mach dè seòrsa beathach a dh'fhaodadh a bhith ann. Oona and Sily's plan to spend the day swimming with dolphins is brought to a halt when a strange creature scares poor Silky witless. The pair visit Bernie to learn who, or what, this creature could possibly be.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing a’ cluich geama le fòn-làimhe Flop, chaneil rudan a’ dol mar bu chòir oir tha am fòn-làimhe a' briseadh nuair a tha e dol na sgeing air an làr. An àite seo innse do Flop, tha Bing ga chuir dhan bhiona. Tha e faireachdainn cho dona mun seo ach tha e ag ionnsachadh gum feum e innse mar a thachair. When Bing is playing a game with Flop’s mobile phone, he accidentally drops the mobile and it breaks. Instead of telling Flop, he throws it in the bin. He feels upset about it all and learns that it’s best to tell the truth.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing aig cuirm sa phàirc, tha còir aige 'n oidhch' a chrìochnachadh ach tha e air bhioran agus tha e fàs cho diùid. Ge-tà, le taic bho charaidean, tha e faighinn seachad air na duilgheadasan sin agus tha e a' seinn Òran a’ Bhogha-fhroise. When Bing is at a show in the park, he is extremely nervous as he is meant to be singing the finale. However, with help from his friends, Bing gets over all his insecurities and sings the Rainbow Song.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein is a charaidean gann de dh’airgead, is leis nach eil ann an airgead ach pìosan beaga pàipeir le dealbhan orra, tha iad uile a’ co-dhùnadh gun cruthaich iad an t-airgead aca fhèin, is gun ceannaich iad na thogras iad. Because they are a little short of money, and considering cash notes are only little papers with drawings on them, Petit and his friends decide to create their own money and buy anything they want.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda a’ dol gu coinneamh nan Sgùdan Sporais ’son a’ chiad turas, is tha bràiste ri chosnadh. Tha i fhèin ’s a caraidean dol a sgioblachadh sa phàirc. Chan eil gnothaichean ag obrachadh mar a shaoileadh tu, ge-ta! Hilda goes to a Sparrow Scouts meeting for the first time, and there is a badge to be earned. She and her friends tidy up in the park, but things don’t work out as you would imagine!

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Nuair a tha aig Minho ri fuireach airson greiseag aig taigh Granaidh, chan eil a’ chùis ri còrdadh ris. Tha e taingeil, ge-tà, gu bheil Mango, a charaid, còmhla ris. When Minho has to stay at Granny’s for a while, he isn’t happy. He is, however, glad that his friend Mango is with him.

programme.title: Oidhche Shamhna CBBC ALBA
programme.desc: Tanith Rothach le taghadh a tha eagalach fhèin math airson Oidhche Shamhna, le slaidhm, braimeannan agus taibhse no dhà cuideachd! Tanith Munro introduces some frighteningly good highlights for Halloween, with slime, farts and a ghost or two!

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha Flix 'son dearbhadh g’ eil easan na shàr chat feireil – dìreach mar athair, Zeno. Chan eil a nàmhaid, Burma, dol a dhèanamh chùisean furasta dha, ge-tà! Flix wants to prove that he’s an ultimate outdoor cat - just like his dad, Zeno. However his nemesis Burma isn’t going to make things easy for him!

programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Seachd Là
programme.desc: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Salm 69 air a sheinn le Calum Ailig Mac a' Mhaolain, an laoidh Solas Na Grèine le Ceathrar-cheòil Còisir Ghàidhlig Ìleach Ghaschu agus bidh Mairead MacFhionghain ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na beatha fhèin. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Psalm 69 sung by Calum Alex MacMillan, the hymn Solas na Grèine by Glasgow Islay Gaelic Choir Quartet and Margaret MacKinnon tells her own personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Tha Erica Nic a’ Phearsain air ais a’ toirt cruth-atharrachadh àlainn air seòmaran agus toglaichean le a dealbhachadh sònraichte. Leanaidh sinn i bho thoiseach gu deireadh phròiseactan is sinn a’ faicinn gach pàirt den phròiseas, bho phlana air pàipear gu bhith a’ trusadh stuthan airson crìoch snasail a chur orra. Interior designer Erica MacPherson is back to transform more rooms, homes and businesses. We follow her process from architectural plans to trawling auction houses and shops for finishing touches. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Sailm nan Daoine
programme.desc: Tha an ceòladair Rob MacNeacail air turas gus cumhachd seinn nan salm Gàidhlig a sgaoileadh. Musician Rob MacNeacail is on a mission to spread the power of Gaelic psalm singing.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le The Atholl Set ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform The Atholl Set in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh/Scotland Underground
programme.desc: In the Highlands and Islands, Calum explores the caves of Assynt, a Unesco global geopark, before travelling north to Orkney where there is a wealth of archeological underground sites. But it is also an example of the modern use of subterranean sites: oil to service the Scapa Flow naval sites was hidden underground in vast tanks beneath Wee Fea hill. The war theme continues as Calum visits a Cold War underground bunker in Inverness. Anns a’ Ghàidhealtachd agus na h-Eileanan, bheir Calum cuairt tro uamhan Asainte, geò-pàirc cruinneil UNESCO. À sin, thèid e tuath gu Arcaibh far a bheil beartas de làraich arceòlach fon talamh, ach cuideachd eisimpleir nas ùire den fho-thalamh a chleachdadh. Fo chnoc Wee Fea, tha na tancaichean mòra a bha a’ cumail ola ri làrach a’ Chabhlaich Rìoghail ann an Scapa Flow. A’ cumail ri tèama a’ chogaidh, ann an Inbhirnis tadhlaidh Calum air buncair bho àm a’ Chogaidh Fhuair. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.desc: Fader Brown utreder när en filmproducent mördas under produktionen av B-filmen Demon Brides i Kembleford. Men kommissarie Mallory uppskattar inte prästens hjälp...

programme.title: Fader Brown
programme.desc: Sid har tur - Han vaknar bredvid en vacker kvinna på morgonen. Men lyckan är inte bestående för kvinnan är såväl gift som mordmisstänkt. Vem kan rädda henne? Produktion - BBC.

programme.title: Fader Brown
programme.desc: Den fd bödeln Henry Lee blir konfronterad av en kvinna vars son blivit avrättad för mord ett år tidigare. Hon påstår att den dömde sonens sista ord till Lee var namnet på den verklige mördaren, en polisman. Fader Brown blir indragen i en väv av lögner och svek inom polisen. Samtidigt upplever mrs McCarthy lite romantik.

programme.title: Hela England syr
programme.desc: Säsong 7, 1/10. Tävlingen startar med spänning och skräck i luften! Under den första veckan syr tävlarna baskläder. Mönsteruppgiften är en damblus som knäpps i ryggen med knappar. I omvandlingen skall baskläder göras om till något mycket mer spännande. I den sista uppgiften syr tävlarna prärieklänningar.

programme.title: Hela England syr
programme.desc: Säsong 7, 2/10. Tävlingen trappas upp när sommarveckan börjar. I mönsteruppgiften syr man paperbag shorts och i omvandligen gör tävlarna en damdress till sommarkvällen av badshorts. I den sista uppgiften skall tävlarna skapa en sommarklänning med knappar på fem timmar.

programme.title: Hela England syr
programme.desc: Under klassikerveckan för män tillverkar amatörskräddarna gubbkepsar, förvandlar gamla jackor till kvinnokläder och skapar en avslappnad funktionell jacka.

programme.title: Reseman - 48 timmar i ...
programme.desc: Richard får sällskap av skådespelaren Fay Ripley för en vintrig minisemester i Oslo. Tillsammans packar de två dagar med pulka, skrik, skidåkning, skulptur och hån. Trots att han är en stolt halvnorrman, lyckas Richard uppbåda en glimt av objektivitet. Richard tar med Fay till Oslos hippaste hotell, The Thief, hem till en konstsamling som inkluderar verk av Warhol, Hirst och Koons. Senare i showen bestämmer de sig för att kolla in vintersportalternativen och de försöker hålla sig upprätt tillräckligt länge för att bemästra längdskidåkning. Paret njuter vidare av en dubbel dos konst och besöker Nationalgalleriet för att kolla in Munchs mästerverk och ta en snörik promenad runt Vigelandsparken. De provar nordiskt käk med Michelin-stjärnor och äter en av världens bästa korvar i en historisk kiosk innan de slutligen provsmakar läckerheterna i Mini Bottle Gallery.

programme.title: Reseman - 48 timmar i ...
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade får sällskap av komikern Lou Sanders för en tvådagars tur runt Bergen. De utforskar bergen och fjordarna som omger den, samt upplever det bästa som denna norska stad har att erbjuda. Paret utforskar den historiska stadsdelen Bryggen innan de tar linbanan till toppen av berget Ulriken där de testar den snabbaste ziplinen i Norge. Efter det beger Richard och Lou sig på ett gastronomiskt äventyr när deras guide Marrian lotsar dem till en liten ö för en måltid där födan delvis tillagas över öppen eld. Deras semester fortsätter med bestigningen av ett annat berg, när Richard och Lou tar bergbanan Floibanen till toppen av Mount Floyen. Här tar de en trädplanteringstur, kollar in Tuba Kuba och Lou blir stångad av en get.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Will and Dan tackle a scale model of the world’s only rotating boat lift: the Falkirk Wheel. There are missing cogs and broken bearings, while an underperforming motor demand precision repairs. In the barn, Dom entrusts Wappy - a soft toy that saw Robbie through life-saving treatment in Dundee - to Julie and Amanda for a sensitive rebuild, before Will swaps timber for silver as he makes a decorative bowl with celebrated silversmith Katie Watson.

programme.title: Our Lives
programme.desc: This Our Lives documentary tells the story of Boots and Beards, a Scots Asian-run hillwalking group helping people from ethnic minority backgrounds explore the great outdoors. We join the group as it gathers once again after a year in lockdown and prepares to celebrate its landmark 100th walk. We meet the group’s founders, Naveed Baksh and Kashif Butt, whose close friendship has been a driving force behind the success of the group. Their fortnightly hillwalks began as a way to spend more time with close friends and family, but have grown into a community event that has transformed lives. Naveed also travels to Fort William, the small Highland town where his parents first settled when coming to the UK. There, he’s joined by Kashif for a walk up Ben Nevis, the highest mountain in the country and the pair’s greatest hillwalking challenge to date.

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: Witches dominate popular culture, but behind the fantasy lies a brutal history of female persecution. Evelyn and Zara investigate the mysterious case of Lilias Adie, a local woman accused of witchcraft in Torryburn, Fife, in 1704 - with shocking results.

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: UFOs, alien encounters, government cover-ups and mysterious lights in the sky - the myths surrounding extraterrestrial life have fascinated us for decades. But where does the truth end and the legend begin? Zara and Evelyn head to Scotland’s infamous Falkirk Triangle, a UFO hotspot at the centre of extraordinary claims, to investigate why these stories take hold and whether there is any truth behind them. Meeting passionate UFO spotters, a sceptical academic and a former RAF press officer, they explore how science fiction, media hype and conspiracy theories have helped fuel our fascination with the unexplained. From claims of secret government files to the remarkable case of forestry worker Robert Taylor, whose alleged encounter in 1979 remains shrouded in mystery, Zara and Evelyn uncover the stories behind Scotland’s enduring UFO mythology. With eyewitness accounts, archive footage and intriguing forensic evidence, can Zara and Evelyn separate fact from folklore? Are these sightings misunderstood phenomena, myths that have taken on a life of their own, or evidence that we’re not alone?

programme.desc: When Villanelle kills a Chinese colonel at a kink clinic in Berlin, Eve and Bill travel out to investigate. While they follow a number of promising leads, Villanelle enjoys the cat-and-mouse nature of their proximity.

programme.title: Killing Eve
programme.desc: Information from Berlin indicates the existence of a mole, which leads Eve to enter into her first surveillance operation. Meanwhile, Villanelle is tasked with taking out a member of the British Intelligence.

programme.title: Film Club
programme.desc: While Evie throws herself headlong at life, Suz and Josh worry it's too much, too soon. Meanwhile, Noa realises he has to face up to his feelings...

programme.title: Film Club
programme.desc: Her world rocked, Evie has retreated to the safety of the garage. But with a new understanding, Suz and Izzie create a unique version of Film Club to bring back Evie's smile.

programme.title: Film Club
programme.desc: Noa didn't want a big goodbye, but now the day's finally come for him to leave, will Evie let him go that easily? It's not the only big decision she has to face...

programme.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
programme.desc: The venue for the sixth heat of the competition is The Box at FarGo Village, Coventry, a repurposed industrial space in the city centre, which has, for one night only, been transformed into a comedy club. The host is Coventry's own Josh Pugh.

programme.title: Sort Your Life Out
programme.desc: Stacey and her gang challenge the Wellen family to sort their life out in seven days. They have to embark on a mammoth declutter, with the family asked to let go of half of their possessions so that the team can beautifully reorganise their home.

programme.title: This is BBC Three
programme.desc: This is BBC Three. Programmes start at 7.00pm.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Shaun the Sheep and his flock turn farm life upside down with wild adventures, sneaky tricks and nonstop laughs. Bitzer the dog tries to keep order, but Shaun always has a plan!

programme.title: Danger Mouse
programme.desc: Penfold's countless hours spent playing Giraffe Warriors pay off when he gets the highest score of all time. Before he can convince Danger Mouse that a video game win is a real life win, the pair are whisked off to the planet which inspired the game.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Herbert takes his failed cooling hat invention along on a quest, using it to save the day after being faced with the Riddlemaster's jibes.

programme.title: Boy Girl Dog Cat Mouse Cheese
programme.desc: When the siblings try to kick their annoying habits for the sake of family unity, they offer each other mutual support, only to crack one by one. The stress mounts on Boy & Girl, the last two survivors, to make it to the finish line.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy is on his way back from a fishing outing when he unwittingly brings back an electrode with the power to control a robot.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings accidentally stumble upon drawings of Tai Chi movements in a temple. They are eager to learn the moves.

programme.title: Blue Lights
programme.desc: Sandra enlists help to expose Gerry’s secrets, while Tommy and Shane inch closer to exposing the drug pipeline.

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: Lee finds an undiscovered Banksy and attempts to steal the artwork in a foolhardy quest for fame and fortune. When he is collared by a security guard, however, he panics and hints that he might be Banksy to get away. Now, he finds himself at the centre of a blackmail plot.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Flutter is sent to the ‘naughty berg’ as punishment when he falls foul of an old Piri rule. But when the others start telling tales, he’s not the only one to be banished.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Whilst Dad searches for a faulty wire, Cosima and Big Lizard play tag in the ship and accidentally break Big Lizard's bath bed! Where will he sleep now? And where's that pesky wire?

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: While playing baseball, Weasy hits a ball out of bounds. It lands on a scary scarecrow, which frightens the ducklings. Weasy makes fun of them, but he's scared, too! He leaves without the ball but refuses to admit that he’s afraid.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: The heroes quest on Spookyween to stop whatever is menacing the pumpkin patch and find that a headless skeleton is using pumpkins as a head.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a magic hat that can transform them to match their costumes.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck and Frog are excited when they get a job as movie extras. But they end up destroying every take, irritating the director, who has a very short fuse.

programme.title: Bro's in Control
programme.desc: Can Joe and Adam scare Traitors stars Freddie Fraser and Jessie Roux?

programme.title: Gladiators: Epic Pranks
programme.desc: Nitro and Viper team up with Carys for a spooky Halloween prank on her friends. They face a farting vampire, spooky scares in the dark and a nightmare factory full of surprises!

programme.title: Stage Stars
programme.desc: With Halloween approaching, the Year 7s have been told about the school ghost and set off to hunt for it. Meanwhile, the Anything Goes cast try not to get too spooked by the thought of opening night for their show, and Encore - the most senior dancers at the school - warm up for their next big show.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Shini, Abby and Hacker celebrate Halloween at a spooktacular theme park, testing which attraction is scariest and showing us how to make tasty vampire teeth treats!

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall heads to Oman in search of the most cryptically camouflaged animals of the underwater world. They range from leopard sharks to the octopus, and cuttlefish to a giant moray eel.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the growing season draws to a close, it’s time to catch up with Adam Frost in his new garden - and he’s been busy. The base of the greenhouse is now in, and there’s turf to lay, soft fruit to get in the ground and a shady border to plant up. In the Peak District, Rekha Mistry offers up some more timely advice on how to grow veg in pots, while Rachel de Thame heads to Nottinghamshire to revel in that autumn stalwart, the hardy chrysanthemum. The wonderful world of Japanese maples comes under the spotlight as a mother and daughter share their love of these beautiful trees. And Advolly Richmond delves into the colourful history behind the gardens at Blenheim Palace.

programme.title: Odette
programme.desc: The stirring true story of a courageous Frenchwoman who returned to her occupied homeland to spy for the Special Operations Executive during the Second World War.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: Marcus steps things up with a hunt for the perfect cow. He heads to Shropshire in search of a rare breed that has been around in England for centuries, the English Longhorn. A close encounter with a bull isn’t enough to put him off after he tastes the delicious product. Back on the farm, he harvests his own horseradish before developing a special recipe for horseradish sauce. While some goes in the cupboard, much of it forms Marcus’s contribution to a sharing event with the local community down at the village pub. And once the new Longhorns are in place, it's time for a special celebration meal with beef at its very heart.

programme.title: Nadiya’s Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya shares some deliciously simple family bakes, from daughter Maryam’s ultimate jam and chocolate flapjacks to an easy, oven-baked chilli topped with crunchy tortillas.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Elinor and Marianne Dashwood are thrown into sudden hardship on the death of their father as their brother, John, inherits his fortune. In straitened circumstances, they are taken in by a kindly cousin, but the lack of fortune affects the marriageability of both the practical Elinor and the romantic Marianne.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Members of the public bring their antiques to be viewed and valued.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: Four famous faces paired with a friend or a loved one must tackle the most formidable race yet - traversing the ancient jungles and indigenous heartlands of Borneo to the southern tip of Australia.

programme.title: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: 1940. Britain fears an impending German invasion. Goering is confident his Luftwaffe will pave the way for success. It falls to brave squadrons of fighter pilots to fend off the attack from the air.

programme.title: Serie A
programme.desc: Live coverage of AC Milan v Inter Milan in the Italian Serie A.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Relive some of the biggest hits of 1996 with these Top of the Pops classic performances. Summer hits were aplenty with Peter Andre, Gina G and Los Del Rio all bringing sunshine to Elstree. Hooks in hip-hop proved dominant with Dr Dre, Blackstreet, Mark Morrison, Toni Braxton and the Fugees all scoring huge hits. Britpop was still booming, with Oasis continuing to dominate singles sales with Sleeper hot on their heels. Global dance classics were born courtesy of Faithless and Robert Miles, and add into the mix the awesome arrival of Spice Girls, plus many more, and it’s not a year to miss. Artists featured include Spice Girls, Suede, The Fugees, Babylon Zoo, Beautiful South, Mark Morrison, Sleeper, Los Del Rio, Peter Andre, Alanis Morrisette, Manics, Dr Dre, Blackstreet, Robret Miles, Space, OMC, Garbage, Gina G, Kula Shaker, Toni Braxton, Babybird and Oasis.

programme.title: Oasis – Live at Manchester City Stadium
programme.desc: Oasis, one of the world's biggest touring bands pulls out all the stops during their 2005 world tour. Following the release of a sixth studio album, they return to their hometown of Manchester for a triumphant concert at the City of Manchester Stadium. The performance includes Lyla, Songbird, The Importance of Being Idle, Live Forever, Don’t Look Back in Anger, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Rock 'n' Roll Star and a raucous version of The Who’s classic anthem My Generation.

programme.title: Oasis - Right Here, Right Now
programme.desc: First broadcast in 1997, this documentary gives the band's account of their previous year. Featuring exclusive performances and detailed interviews with the Gallaghers.

programme.title: No Bears
programme.desc: A dissident film-maker who is trying to direct a movie in Turkey while being forced to remain in a nearby Iranian border town finds himself embroiled in a local scandal.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: The Porthcawl crew’s training night is disrupted when a call comes from a dog walker who has spotted a surfer in trouble below the cliffs at nearby Rest Bay. During the peak of a cyclone known as Storm Amy, Bridlington’s lifeboat is tasked to a Dutch trawler that has lost power 13 miles off the Yorkshire coast. In Ireland, an urgent call comes in to the Crosshaven crew from a yacht taking part in a local race; on board, an elderly sailor is reported to have broken his leg. The Calshot crew face a tense search in thick fog for a motorboat with engine failure - somewhere in the busy shipping lanes of the Solent. And reports of a submerged car in the Thames put the Chiswick crew on red alert.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: After discovering that the person responsible for Ricardo’s death is someone close to him, Michael scrambles for a way to protect them from the consequences – without jeopardising Diana.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: In this year’s Countryfile Ramble for BBC Children in Need, Matt Baker, Anita Rani, Margherita Taylor, Joe Crowley and John Craven lace up their walking boots to meet inspirational young people whose lives have been transformed through support from BBC Children in Need. The ramble is returning for its 12th year, set against the stunning backdrop of the Peak District. The presenters walk alongside five remarkable young people who have faced significant challenges, hearing first-hand how BBC Children in Need-funded projects have helped them build confidence, resilience and hope for the future.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie is in Aberdeenshire, visiting Scotland’s first inclusive farm, built by a blind farmer who is determined to make agriculture accessible for all. Arlene sails to Jura to see how the locals cope with the huge deer population and find new outlets for venison. Anne discovers how the shortage of affordable rural housing is being tackled in the Highlands. And Shahbaz is on the shores of Loch Linnhe near Fort William to see the stranded fishing boat that has become a local landmark.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek is island-hopping in this round-up of his favourite Welsh island walks. He goes wild in west Wales as he sails to Skomer Island – a national nature reserve of international importance due to its seabirds - where he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. Next, Derek goes to Flat Holm Island, where he braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements. Lastly, Derek heads up north to Wales's largest island, Anglesey, where he visits another tiny island with a secluded chapel, an unexpected motor racing track, a neolithic burial chamber and a sauna on a beach.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt dishes up a feast of food from the Saturday Kitchen archives to whet the appetite for the week ahead. The Hairy Bikers bring comfort food bang up to date with sticky Szechuan lamb, stuffed into pillowy soft bao buns, with a fresh hit of pickled carrots, spring onion and herbs – cosy comfort with a fragrant Asian twist! Meera Sodha introduces a taste of Sri Lanka to the studio as she continues the comfort theme with her warming lentil and coconut dal with crispy mustard kale. Jeremy Lee brings his effervescent charm and wit to the kitchen whilst giving an underused cut of meat its chance in the spotlight. He makes a rich steamed kid pudding that melts in the mouth. Mary McCartney celebrates Bonfire Night with her flavour-packed smoky dogs, while Carmen O’Neal and Idris Elba team up to serve a masterclass in brandy. And queen of puddings Nigella Lawson tucks into either her food heaven, scallops, or her food hell, candied fruit. Meanwhile, Rick Stein explores the New Forest's bounty of produce, and the Hairy Bikers make a Menorcan dish in the Mediterranean Sea.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Sitting between Germany and France, Alsace is frontier land with a cuisine to match. In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer (brassier means ‘to brew’) and a deliciously creamy tarte flambee. Then there's a trip to guide Coralie Andt’s restaurant, known as a winstub, where French wines can be enjoyed with plenty of cheese and sausage – as well as more sausage with sauerkraut cooked in white Riesling wine. With French tarts in a brasserie that serves German-style beer, and German sausage in a winstub serving French white wine, Alsace is defined by its competing national influences.

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: With Britain more obsessed with baking than ever, actress and cake expert Jane Asher brings together a selection of recipes from the nation's favourite television chefs, for Best Bakes Ever. Each episode gives baking fans another chance to experience classic dishes from the likes of the James Martin, Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, the Hairy Bikers, Raymond Blanc, Nigella Lawson, Tom Kerridge, Lorraine Pascale and Rachel Khoo. There's added insight and appreciation from Jane herself too. Whether its cakes, pies, puddings or main courses - this greatest hits of baking is a must for anyone with a need to knead, and should help inspire even more of us to start getting creative in the kitchen.

programme.title: I Was Monty's Double
programme.desc: World War II drama. A low-ranking officer who resembles General Montgomery is recruited to play his double in an elaborate plan to trick the Nazis.

programme.title: Women's Super League
programme.desc: Women's Super League action as Charlton Athletic face Chelsea.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin introduces a collection of the best finds from the show's travels to Lulworth Castle in Dorset, Chiddingstone Castle in Kent, and Wrest Park in Bedfordshire. The antiques experts include Catherine Southon, Christina Trevanion, Adam Partridge, Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, with items ranging from a cloisonne vase to an astonishing collection of First World War slides. Paul also finds out more about the ancient art of shipbuilding at Buckler's Hard in Hampshire.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: For a live demonstration of terroir, Eva heads to Domaine Dujac, home of the current most-wanted Burgundy wine. Standing on one side of a road, owner Jeremy Seysses points to a parcel of grand cru (the very best) of Clos de la Roche. On the other side is a premier cru (the next best) - a Gevrey-Chambertin Combottes. Back at the winery, Eva tucks into beef cheeks bathed in Domaine Dujac for a classic boeuf bourguignon lunch. Despite the grapes being grown just a few metres away, these reds are a class apart.

programme.title: Wild Horses, the Rockies and Me
programme.desc: Gordon Buchanan heads to the Rocky Mountains in search of wild horses. Finding two stallions battling over a herd, Gordon immerses himself in their world, hoping to win their trust.

programme.title: BBC Young Musician
programme.desc: Who will be crowned the winner? Three virtuosic performers vie for the coveted title in a thrilling concert at Bristol Beacon. Presented by Petroc Trelawny.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob are back in Norfolk - a bittersweet return, as this was the very first location where Ted joined them. They both reminisce about Ted and raise a cup in his memory - although Ted would have preferred a biscuit. They head to some prime Norfolk lakes, hoping to catch a bream. It’s been well documented that Bob is not a fan of the bream, but will a big catch make him change his tune? It's Paul and Bob's birthday week, and they consider whether they may celebrate any further milestones or simply let them pass. Bob ends up throwing a surprise 70s-themed birthday party for Paul on the roof of the Blickling Estate, once owned by the Boleyn family.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Irish film star Chris O'Dowd joins Bill Murray and his friend Tom Coyne for a lively round of golf, with enthusiasm occasionally outstripping ability. Away from the fairways, a traditional rambling house takes Bill outside his comfort zone as he explores Ireland's rich storytelling traditions. Later, in a packed Irish pub, the music starts – and staying on the sidelines proves impossible.

programme.title: Later... with Jools Holland
programme.desc: Jools welcomes Skepta, Jordan Rakei, Bloc Party, Johnny and Lillie Flynn, corto.alto and Rita Wilson.

programme.title: Walk the Line
programme.desc: The story of the legendary country artist Johnny Cash, from his early days on an Arkansas cotton farm to his rise to fame with Sun Records and his long association with singer June Carter, later to become his wife.

PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten (19)
Neue Geschichten vom Pumuckl (9)
programme.desc: Es ist ein grauer, regnerischer Tag. Pumuckl quält die Langeweile. Kein Vorschlag von Eder kann ihn aufheitern. Plötzlich stehen unangekündigt zwei Prüfer der Gewerbeaufsicht vor der Tür. Ausgerechnet heute! Eder passt das gar nicht. Pumuckl darf jetzt keinen Unfug machen. Denn die Gewerbeaufsicht kann die Werkstatt im schlimmsten Fall schließen! Pumuckl fühlt sich herausgefordert. Die Werkstatt gehört ihm, und diese Prüfer sollen ganz schnell wieder gehen! Der auf Regeln versessene Prüfer Herr Hohoff und seine Kollegin Frau Lange machen sich ans Werk. Schnell stellen sie fest, dass in der alten Werkstatt kaum etwas den aktuellen Sicherheitsvorschriften entspricht. Eder bangt um seine Betriebserlaubnis. Vor allem, weil Pumuckl sich nicht an die Abmachung hält, sich unauffällig zu verhalten. Eder sieht sich gezwungen, den renitenten Kobold einzusperren: im Kühlschrank. Doch Pumuckl hat mit seinem Schabernack bereits dafür gesorgt, dass der penible Prüfer in eine ziemlich blamable Situation gerät. Es sieht so aus, als hätte er die ganze Werkstatt verwüstet! Eder ist sprachlos, als er das Chaos sieht. Doch er nutzt die Chance, um sich die Sicherheit der Werkstatt bescheinigen zu lassen. Und so ziehen die Prüfer von dannen. Mit schlechtem Gewissen befreit Eder Pumuckl aus dem Kühlschrank, der nie wieder mit ihm sprechen möchte. Eder entschuldigt sich aufrichtig bei ihm. Er muss zugeben, dass Pumuckls Schabernack heute die Werkstatt gerettet hat.

programme.title: Submarine Jim (13)
programme.desc: Seit Monaten arbeitet die Crew ohne Pause. Die Flossen sind schlapp, die Stimmung ist im Keller. Also beschließt Jim großzügig, seinen Flossenflitzern eine wohlverdiente Auszeit zu gönnen, und steuert einen idyllischen See zum Campen an. Doch kaum sind alle im Urlaubsmodus, merkt Jim: Ohne Käpt'ns-Privilegien fühlt sich das Leben irgendwie seltsam an. Niemand nennt ihn mehr "Käpt'n", er muss Schlange stehen, und beim Karaoke darf er auch nicht singen. Doch langsam lernt Jim, loszulassen und einfach nur "Jim" zu sein, aber gerade als er beginnt, den Urlaub wirklich zu genießen, ist die Pause schon wieder vorbei. Die Crew will zurück zur Mission und Jim will bleiben. Mit immer neuen Ausreden versucht er, die Abreise hinauszuzögern. Als jedoch plötzlich das Salzwasser knapp wird und alle in Gefahr geraten, erinnert sich Jim daran, was es wirklich heißt, Käpt'n zu sein. Und manchmal bedeutet das eben auch, den Urlaub zu beenden.

programme.title: Submarine Jim (14)
programme.desc: Eigentlich gleitet das U-Boot friedlich dahin. Die Flossenflitzer dösen, kichern, und spielen - und nehmen das Leben ziemlich locker. Doch Siggi spürt es in seinen akkurat sortierten Gräten: An Bord herrscht Disziplin-Ebbe. Das möchte Siggi ändern und plötzlich taucht wie durch "Zauberflosse" auf dem Sonar ein roter Punkt auf. Es soll sich um das berüchtigte U-Boot "Fieser Hai" handeln - angeblich randvoll mit fiesen Haien, die nichts lieber tun, als andere Crews zum Abendessen zu verspeisen. Panik wabert durch die Bullaugen, während Käpt'n Jim zwischen Mut und Muffensausen hin- und her flattert. Immer wieder verschwindet das unheimliche Fahrzeug, nur um erneut aufzutauchen. Alarm, Entwarnung, Alarm, Entwarnung - und zwischendurch Limbo, Fitnesspause und Entenangel-Spiel. Doch irgendwann reicht es Käpt'n Jim. Statt weiter davon zu flitzen, will er den Spieß umdrehen: Angriff ist die beste Verteidigung! Was folgt, ist ein heldenhafter - und leicht chaotischer - Einsatz, der in einem völlig unerwarteten Geständnis endet. Denn hinter der ganzen Haifisch-Hysterie steckt etwas ganz anderes... Am Ende lernen alle eine wichtige Lektion: Spaß ist wunderbar - aber manchmal braucht selbst ein fröhliches U-Boot eine Prise Ernsthaftigkeit.

programme.title: Gänsehaut
programme.desc: Noch immer verärgert über den Umzug von der Großstadt in den öden Vorort Madison, findet der Teenager Zach Cooper einen Silberstreif am Horizont, als er die Nachbarstochter Hannah trifft, die gleich nebenan lebt. Ihr Vater ist R. L. Stine, der Autor der Bestseller-Serie "Gänsehaut". Es stellt sich heraus, dass es einen Grund gibt, warum Stine so seltsam ist. Die Monster seiner Geschichten sind realer als ihm lieb ist, und Stine schützt seine Leser, indem er sie in ihren Büchern eingesperrt hält. Als die Teenager eines seiner Bücher öffnen, nimmt das Unheil seinen Lauf und alle Monster aus Stines Geschichten finden den Weg in die Realität. Und sie wollen nur eins: die Stadt zerstören.

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten V (29)
PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten (21)
PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten (22)
Neue Geschichten vom Pumuckl (10)
programme.desc: Michi will mit seiner neuen Freundin Vicky zum Karneval gehen. Doch wer schaut bei ihren beiden Kindern nach dem Rechten? Zusammen mit seiner Stieftochter Johanna bittet er Eder um diesen Gefallen. Als Johanna erzählt, dass sie einen unsichtbaren Freund hat, ist Pumuckls Interesse geweckt. Ein Nilpferd, das in Johannas Hosentasche wohnt? Das muss er kennenlernen! Er folgt Michi und Johanna nach Hause. Doch als er mitbekommt, dass Mela, die Tochter von Michi, und ihre Freunde nicht an unsichtbare Wesen glauben, will Pumuckl sie eines Besseren belehren. Die Küche versinkt im Chaos. Verängstigt suchen die Jugendlichen bald das Weite. Auch Eder kann das Chaos nicht mehr rechtzeitig beseitigen, bevor Michi und Vicky wieder zurückkommen. Michi ist wütend auf die Ausrede von Mela, das sei wohl das unsichtbare Nilpferd gewesen. Und Vicky ist wütend auf Michi, der die Phantasie von Johanna kritisiert. Es kommt zum Streit. Frustriert gibt Michi Eder die Schuld. Hätte er doch früher mal nach dem Rechten geschaut! Zurück in der Werkstatt bekommt Pumuckl ein schlechtes Gewissen. Eder ist sauer auf ihn. Wie kann er das nur wieder gut machen? Sein geliebtes Holzpferd könnte Johanna beschwichtigen, und dann müsste am Ende auch der Michi sich wieder mit Flori vertragen. Der Plan geht auf. Eder und Michi versöhnen sich wieder. Pumuckl darf am Ende sein Pferd sogar behalten. Und Phantasie, die darf auch weiterhin jeder haben.

programme.title: Barbie in Der Nussknacker
programme.desc: Spielfilm USA (2025). Barbie Malibu schlüpft in die Rolle der Clara, während Barbie Brooklyn als Zuckerfee agiert und Ken den Nussknacker verkörpert. Gemeinsam durchqueren sie verzauberte Welten, um den Nussknacker vor dem hinterlistigen Mäusekönig zu bewahren. Durch eine mitreißende Mischung aus Ballett und Hip-Hop erfahren die Freunde, dass der Glaube an sich selbst und ein starker Zusammenhalt die mächtigste Kraft darstellen, um jedes Ziel zu erreichen. Darsteller: Marina Krogull, Giovanna Winterfeldt, Rieke Werner, Gerrit Schmidt-Foß, Antje von der Ahe, Ilona Otto, Klaus-Peter Grap, Jan-Marten Block, Mackie Heilmann. Regie Bianca Ansems

programme.title: Scooby-Doo und wer bist Du? II (5)
Barbie in Der Nussknacker
programme.desc: Spielfilm USA (2025). Barbie Malibu schlüpft in die Rolle der Clara, während Barbie Brooklyn als Zuckerfee agiert und Ken den Nussknacker verkörpert. Gemeinsam durchqueren sie verzauberte Welten, um den Nussknacker vor dem hinterlistigen Mäusekönig zu bewahren. Durch eine mitreißende Mischung aus Ballett und Hip-Hop erfahren die Freunde, dass der Glaube an sich selbst und ein starker Zusammenhalt die mächtigste Kraft darstellen, um jedes Ziel zu erreichen. Darsteller: Marina Krogull, Giovanna Winterfeldt, Rieke Werner, Gerrit Schmidt-Foß, Antje von der Ahe, Ilona Otto, Klaus-Peter Grap, Jan-Marten Block, Mackie Heilmann. Regie Bianca Ansems

programme.title: A Christmas Post - Die vergessenen Weihnachtswünsche
Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E23 "Panu Smallovi připadá, že děti z Elmorské osmiletky dostatečně neinspiruje, a tak mu Gumball s Darwinem chtějí zvednout náladu. Aby měl pan Small pocit, že své žáky inspiroval, snaží se kluci řídit všemi jeho radami. Když však jeho neurčitá klišé vedou jen k tomu, že ve škole nadělají spoušť, musejí tu pohromu před ním zatajit, aby mu nedošlo, jak příšerné jeho rady byly."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E24 "Gumball se začne podivně zadrhávat a nechtěně tím urazí Darwina. Když ho Darwin požádá o radu s výběrem čepice, Gumball z ničeho nic nedokáže promluvit a Darwina se to dotkne. Je přesvědčený, že o něm Gumball řekl, že má tlustou hlavu. Když to chce Gumball uvést na pravou míru, začne mít potíže s řečí i pohyby. Brzy zjistí, že možná není jediný, kdo má v Elmore problémy s komunikací…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E22 Jamie si usmyslí, že potřebuje chlapce, a naneštěstí pro Darwina usoudí, že nejvhodnějším kandidátem je právě on. Když se Jamie nemá s kým podělit o oběd, uvědomí si, že potřebuje kluka. Darwin jako jediný okamžitě nevezme do zaječích, a tak chtě nechtě skončí spolu. Darwin si myslí, že nejlepší bude vše v tichosti přečkat, dokud se to jeho nové přítelkyni neomrzí. Ale neříct ani slovo je občas těžší, než se zdá.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E25 "Gumball zjistí, že jeho bývalý úhlavní nepřítel Rob se teď nepřátelí s někým jiným. Gumball je zdrcený, že Rob už ho nenenávidí. Odmítá přijmout, že jeho někdejší sok si našel někoho jiného, a udělá vše, co je v jeho silách, aby překazil slibně se rozvíjející vztah Roba s jeho novým nepřítelem Banánem Joem."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E29 "Gumball s Darwinem jsou svědky toho, jak si školní tyrani utahují ze Sussie, a rozhodnou se, že ji naučí chovat se méně divně. Pozorně její chování prostudují a dojdou k závěru, že jediné, co musí změnit, je úplně všechno."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E27 "Klenotem Tajného menu v Bezva Burgeru je záhadný hamburger, který si můžete objednat, jen pokud víte, jak se nazývá. Když jim Larry ono jméno odmítne prozradit, vynaloží Wattersonovi extra velkou porci úsilí na to, aby ho odhalili."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E28 "Když Gumball zjistí, že jejich osmibitový kamarád Ocho má za strýce italského instalatéra jménem Mario, usoudí, že je to ten ze hry Super Mario a řekne, že udělá vše, aby se s ním mohl setkat. Aby dokázal, že je pro Ocha dostatečně blízkým kamarádem a mohl se seznámit s jeho rodinou, musí podstoupit Ochovu náročnou zkoušku přátelství."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E30 "Richard nemůže sundat z hlavy motocyklistickou helmu, takže když přijde do banky, zděšení zaměstnanci si myslí, že je lupič, a odevzdají mu hromadu peněz. Richard odchází s penězi a vůbec mu nedochází, že právě spáchal bankovní loupež. Nicole s dětmi mu brzy vysvětlí, co provedl, a snaží se najít způsob, jak se vyhnout policejnímu stíhání a peníze vrátit."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E35 "Když Lesliemu začnou opadávat okvětní lístky, má pocit, že jeho krása uvadá. Gumball s Darwinem využijí veškerých svých znalostí o stylu a kráse, aby mu pomohli. Jediný problém je v tom, že o stylu a kráse nevědí vůbec nic. Jejich metody jsou stále extrémnější a Leslie začíná pochybovat o tom, jestli chce pro krásu obětovat všechno."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E37 "Když Wattersonovi dostanou předvolání, aby se dostavili na radnici, obávají se nejhoršího. O to více jsou příjemně překvapeni, když jim starosta nabídne nový dům. Má to ale háček: dům stojí v jiném státě! Starosta Elmoru došel k závěru, že Wattersonovi snižují cenu nemovitostí v celém městě. Pokud chtějí v Elmoru zůstat musí rodina dokázat, že patří mezi spořádané spoluobčany."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E01 "Je první den nového školního roku a táta má za úkol dopravit děti včas do školy. Jenže zaspal a teď nemůže Gumballa, Darwina ani Anais nikde najít. Vydá se proto zpět po vlastních stopách, aby zjistil, co předchozího dne dělal a kde by mohli být."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E02 "Gumball s Darwinem zjistí, že Rob, který jim kdysi přísahal pomstu, se je už nějakou dobu snaží odrovnat… jenže jeho pasti nikdy nefungují. Slitují se nad ním a vytyčí si za cíl pomoct mu stát se perfektním úhlavním nepřítelem. Ale odvedou práci až moc dobře a stvoří superpadoucha, který by se mohl vymknout jejich kontrole…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E03 "Gumball s Darwinem usoudí, že je načase přidat se k někomu do party, a shodnou se, že nejdrsnější gang v celém Elmoru jsou důchodci. Dělají, co můžou, aby mezi ně zapadli, a neváhají zajít do krajnosti, jen aby jim (pomalu a šouravě) nadběhli."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E04 "Když Anais Gumballovi s Darwinem prozradí, že chodí o rok výš než oni, spadnou jim z očí šupiny a otevře se před nimi celý nový svět ostatních studentů Elmorské osmiletky. Gumballem otřese poznání, že mnohé z těchto postav o něm nemají takřka ponětí, a je plně odhodlán vnutit se jim do života."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E05 "Táta zjistí, že babi Jojo a Louie se plánují vzít a odstěhovat se na Floridu. Ve snaze tomu zabránit táta adoptuje Louieho, aby mu mohl zakázat oženit se s babi Jojo. Ale tím spustí řadu adopcí uvnitř rodiny, které se rychle vymknou kontrole a přivodí nečekaný návrat někoho z tátovy minulosti…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E09 "Gumball a Darwin obdrželi okázalou pozvánku na Masaminu narozeninovou oslavu a nyní horlivě usilují najít pro ni ideální dárek. Nejsou ale jediní; všechny děti v Elmoru soutěží o to, kdo pro Masami sežene perfektní dárek."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E16 "Gumball chce panu Fitzgeraldovi dokázat, že je hoden jeho dcery Penny, a rozhodne se stát se na jeden den jeho učněm. Potíž je v tom, že pan Fitzgerald má důležitý pohovor, a Gumballovy nadšené snahy pomáhat možná nadělají víc škody než užitku - jak firmě pana Fitzgeralda, tak Gumballově budoucnosti s Penny."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E06 "Když děda Louie věnuje Gumballovi, Darwinovi a Anais šek na 5000 dolarů, jsou nadšením bez sebe. Okamžitě začnou fantazírovat o tom, jak peníze utratí. Ale pak máma s tátou prohlásí, že peníze místo toho použijí na zaplacení účtů, a vypukne závod, kdo se jako první dostane do banky, aby šek vyinkasoval."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E07 "Gumball s Darwinem přistihnou svou sestřičku Anais, jak trénuje na nemilosrdný souboj, protože ji ve škole obtěžuje nepříjemný spolužák: Billy. Pokusí se ji naučit, jak problém vyřešit bez násilí, ale Billy má jiné plány."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E17 "Darwin si dělal legraci z Gumballovy předvídatelnosti, a tak se Gumball snaží dokázat, že svého kamaráda stále dovede překvapit. Napadne ho, že obejmout na pozdrav kluka, kterého sotva zná, by mohlo mít kýžený efekt. Má pravdu, Darwin to nečekal. Ale Gumball zase nečekal, jaké trapné společenské následky mu to objetí přinese…"

Ale Gumball zase nečekal, jaké trapné společenské následky mu to objetí přinese…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E08 "Gumball s Darwinem jsou zdrceni zjištěním, že pan Robinson - jejich nejoblíbenější člověk na celém světě - prodává dům a stěhuje se z města. Když zjistí, že vytvořit si posledních pár šťastných vzpomínek na pana Robinsona jim nestačí, rozhodnou se jeho odjezdu zabránit… a to tím, že prodej překazí."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E11 "Máma s dětmi odjedou za svou celodenní dřinou a svého zdánlivě líného tátu zanechají v polospánku na pohovce. Máma mu zadala jeden velmi prostý úkol: koupit majonézu. Avšak táta tuto všední úlohu dovede proměnit v epickou výpravu, která ukáže, že jeho každodenní rutina není taková zahálka, jak si jeho rodina představuje."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E10 "Wattersonovi přijedou do obchodního centra a chtějí strávit den nakupováním, ale nedaří se jim najít na parkovišti volné místo. Hledají ho, kde se dá - za použití veškeré své inteligence, vynalézavosti i lstí - ale s postupem času začíná být zoufalé pátrání po volném místě důležitější než samotná návštěva nákupního centra."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E12 Gumball s Darwinem zhlédnou reklamu na nejnovější a nejpokročilejší operační systém pro Boberty a s nadšením Boberta přemluví, aby si ho stáhl. Zpočátku to vypadá jako ohromné zlepšení, ale postupně začnou vycházet najevo četné mouchy nového operačního systému.

programme.desc: S03E49 Duncan závidí Paulovi stoletý trest na hanbě. Je rozhodnutý stát se mistrem lotrovin ve školce, proto se s Pólem skamarádí a nechá se od něj naučit jeho triky, aby dosáhl své vysněné mety.

programme.title: Totální Dramarama
programme.desc: S03E01 Owen omylem spolkne žvýkačku, kterou ochutná poprvé v životě. Aby ochránil své kamarády před jistým výbuchem, odebere se na jejich radu do Žvýkačkové sopky a hodlá se vrhnout do jejího chřtánu.

programme.title: Totální Dramarama
programme.desc: S03E02 Šéf varuje Beth a Codyho, aby nedělali obličeje před jeho zakletým zrcadlem, protože by jim tak mohly zůstat. To se i stane, jen úplně jinak, než si to všichni představovali.

programme.title: Mladí Titáni do toho!
programme.desc: S04E40 "Titány už nebaví každý rok prohrávat soutěž kostýmu s Úlem a proto vymyslí plán, jak vyhrát."

programme.title: Mladí Titáni do toho!
programme.desc: S05E08 "Titáni chtějí být ti nejstrašidelnější koledníci ve městě, a tak z nich Raven s pomocí kouzla udělá příšery."

programme.title: Mladí Titáni do toho!
programme.desc: S06E03 Titáni hostí Halloweenskou party a pozvou Ligu Spravedlnosti. Ale čarodějný lektvar, který Robin připraví, má vedlejší účinky.

programme.title: Mladí Titáni do toho!
programme.desc: S06E29 Když dojde k únosu ducha Halloweenu, musí Titáni spojit síly s Beetlejuicem, aby zachránili svátky.

programme.title: Totální Dramarama

programme.desc: S03E10 Gumball svou špatnou náladou nakazí Darwina, který se přidává k jeho remcání. Mrzoutů si všimnou dobří obyvatelé Elmoru, kteří si Gumballa s Darwinem spletou s malými žebráky a uspořádají pro ně dobročinnou sbírku. Jak Gumball s Darwinem vysvětlí tohle nedorozumění, aniž by strhli vlnu nevole?/Wattersonovi si navzájem vyprávějí strašidelné příběhy na rodinné dovolené, když se jejich auto porouchá v poušti. Nezbývá jim, než důvěřovat úplně cizímu člověku, který vypadá jako děsivý muž z mámina smyšleného příběhu. Když je přivede k opuštěné čerpací stanici, Wattersonovi uvěří vlastnímu děsivým představám.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S03E23 Gumball obdrží děsivý e-mail od strašlivého ducha a rozhodne se ho ignorovat navzdory Darwinově radě. Odmítá to přiznat, ale prokletí se stane skutečností a celou rodinu to vtáhne do jiné dimenze. Gumball a Darwin s pomocí Carrie ale rodinu zachrání./Ředitel Brown dá Gumballovi a Darwinovi starého školního křečka Chrise Morrise, aby se o něj přes víkend postarali. Oni ho však omylem nechají ve škole a místo něj si domů odnesou příčesek ředitele Browna. Překvapivě jim připadá jako nejlepší mazlíček. Když si uvědomí, že skutečného Chrise Morrise nechali ve škole, musí si pospíšit, aby vše napravili, než se na jejich omyl přijde.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E39 "Gumball, Darwin a Carrie se spřáhnou a přesvědčí své spolužáky, že ve škole straší. Během halloweenské prezentace děti Gumballově historce o Gargarothovi Požírači zprvu nevěří; pak ale Carrie nafinguje, že ve třídě příšerně straší. Trojice školu přesvědčí, aby si je najala na vyhánění duchů, a nechávají si zaplatit halloweenskými sladkostmi. Jenže když se ukáže, že Gargaroth skutečně existuje, všichni předpokládají, že Gumball město zachrání."

programme.title: Looney Tunes: Animáky
programme.desc: S05E02 Looney Tunes slaví Halloween. Daffy a Porky doprovází drahého přítele na místo posledního odpočinku. Čarodějnice Hazel pronásleduje přísadu pro svůj lektvar. Sylvester najde podezřelý motel a Bugs se setká s mumií.

programme.title: Looney Tunes: Animáky
programme.desc: S01E03 Sylvester si myslí, že ho straší duch Tweetyho. / Elmer chytá Bugse, ale ten skočí do své nory. Když se pokusí Bugse z nory dostat, něco se stane. / Daffy z chodníku sebere kus žvýkačky, která mu připraví lepivou nepříjemnost.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E28 "Obyvatelé města Elmore se záhadně ztrácejí a příčina těchto zmizení by se Gumballa s Darwinem mohla týkat víc, než si myslí. Z mimořádného zpravodajství se Wattersonovi dozvědí, že jejich soused se stal obětí jednoho ze záhadných zmizení, k nimž došlo napříč městem. Pátrání po stopách je dovede až k podivnému vejci, které, jak se brzy ukáže, patří jejich vlastní Zlé želvě. Wattersonovi si uvědomí, že nesou zodpovědnost za to, aby svého mazlíčka vystopovali, než se svými mláďaty napáchá ve městě další škody."
