programme.desc: S04E01 "Je první den nového školního roku a táta má za úkol dopravit děti včas do školy. Jenže zaspal a teď nemůže Gumballa, Darwina ani Anais nikde najít. Vydá se proto zpět po vlastních stopách, aby zjistil, co předchozího dne dělal a kde by mohli být."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E30 "Školní autobus je unesen, ale sami únosci byli zřejmě uneseni. Když Rocky naznačí, že děti z Elmorské osmiletky chodí za školu, autobus obsadí zločinci, kteří jim chtějí ukázat, jak je školní docházka důležitá. Maskovaní bandité jsou očividně rodiče dětí, kteří předstírají přepadení, aby jim uštědřili lekci, ale když se do toho vloží policie, je jasné, že celou situaci má pod kontrolou někdo jiný než rodiče."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E32 "Ať se Gumball snaží sebevíc, Carmen má za každých okolností se svým názorem navrch. Gumball se snaží získat morální převahu, ale při tom zoufale selže. Rozhodne se, že vylepšení sebe sama není jeho styl. Zbývá mu jediná možnost, dostat Carmen na jeho úroveň."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E33 "Každý člen rodiny si myslí, že to má nejhorší. Gumball a Darwin si myslí, že nejhorší to mají kluci. Máma si myslí, že ženy. Anais si myslí, že děti a táta si myslí, že dospěláci. Dojdou k závěru, že rozhodnout jejich při může jedině to, že každý stráví den v kůži někoho jiného, bez ohledu na to, jestli je moc malý, moc velký nebo nosí podpatky."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E39 "Když děti zjistí, že se mámin život nevyvíjel přesně tak, jak doufala, snaží se jí ulehčit den tím, že jí pomůžou s domácími pracemi. Místo seznamu úkolů ale vezmou omylem seznam jejích přání a pokusí se naplnit všechny Nicoliny životní cíle."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E34 "Když máma získá cenu Zaměstnanec měsíce v Továrně na duhy, má Richard pocit, že za práci, kterou doma dělá, není dostatečně oceněn. Nicole pochybuje o tom, co všechno Richard skutečně dělá, ale když začne Richard stávkovat, je hned jasné, jak je jeho role důležitá."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E38 "Rodina čeká celou noc ve frontě před kinem. Jsou zdrcení, když jim Larry řekne, že se na první promítání Hvězdné odyssey nedostanou. Ale zarytí fanoušci, jako jsou Wattersonovi, jsou odhodlaní vidět film jako první, a tak se musí probojovat do čela řady."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E31 "Elmore se promění v rozezpívané a roztančené město. Každý má ve svém nitru nějakou píseň, ale je vážně třeba, aby všechny spatřily světlo světa?"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E03 "Darwin skončí po škole s obávaným Juliusem, který si z Darwina chce udělat svou novou oběť. Jeho plán se mu ale vymstí a Darwin mu převrátí život naruby."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E08 "Gumball s Darwinem jsou zdrceni zjištěním, že pan Robinson - jejich nejoblíbenější člověk na celém světě - prodává dům a stěhuje se z města. Když zjistí, že vytvořit si posledních pár šťastných vzpomínek na pana Robinsona jim nestačí, rozhodnou se jeho odjezdu zabránit… a to tím, že prodej překazí."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E11 "Máma s dětmi odjedou za svou celodenní dřinou a svého zdánlivě líného tátu zanechají v polospánku na pohovce. Máma mu zadala jeden velmi prostý úkol: koupit majonézu. Avšak táta tuto všední úlohu dovede proměnit v epickou výpravu, která ukáže, že jeho každodenní rutina není taková zahálka, jak si jeho rodina představuje."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E10 "Wattersonovi přijedou do obchodního centra a chtějí strávit den nakupováním, ale nedaří se jim najít na parkovišti volné místo. Hledají ho, kde se dá - za použití veškeré své inteligence, vynalézavosti i lstí - ale s postupem času začíná být zoufalé pátrání po volném místě důležitější než samotná návštěva nákupního centra."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E12 Gumball s Darwinem zhlédnou reklamu na nejnovější a nejpokročilejší operační systém pro Boberty a s nadšením Boberta přemluví, aby si ho stáhl. Zpočátku to vypadá jako ohromné zlepšení, ale postupně začnou vycházet najevo četné mouchy nového operačního systému.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E13 "Gumball je hvězda svého vlastního komiksu, ale nedaří se mu vyrovnat se svému hrdinskému alter egu."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E14 "Gumball si vezme do hlavy, že Penny ho už nemá ráda tolik jako dřív, a rozhodne se nachystat pro ni romantickou výpravu, která jí připomene všechny krásné společně strávené chvíle. Avšak Gumballovo romantické gesto se zvrtne a přivede Penny - a možná i celý jejich vztah - do vážného nebezpečí."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E15 "Gumball a Darwin se snaží odtrhnout od internetu, místo toho ale spadnou do internetové černé díry zvané Elmore Stream."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E18 "Gumball a Darwin se snaží najít na své sousedce, paní Robinsnové, alespoň jednu dobrou vlastnost."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E20 "Když se máma s tátou snaží malému hyperaktivnímu Gumballovi zabránit v tom, aby jim věčně ničil dům a vyčerpával je, rozhodnou se koupit mu domácího mazlíčka. Problém je v tom, že všechny zlaté rybky, které mu koupí, brzy končí spláchnuté do záchodu."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E21 "Darwin zjistí, že se po spláchnutí do záchodu dostal kanály až do moře. Je vyděšený, ale odhodlaný vrátit se zpátky domů k Wattersonovým. Ryba se však po souši moc daleko nedostane a tak musí Darwin během pouhých pár hodin překonat mnoho milionů let evoluce, aby se do svého nového domova mohl v pořádku vrátit."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E19 "Alan se vykašlal na Gumballa, aby se věnoval něčemu zábavnějšímu, a tak se ho Gumball ze všech sil snaží vypátrat a potrestat za jeho zradu. Gumball se sebezapřením připravil pro Alana báječnou večeři jako omluvu za to, jak se k němu dříve choval. Když Alan večeři odvolá, je Gumball radostí bez sebe. Pak ale příspěvek na Elmore Plus odhalí, že Alan jen lhal, že je jeho máma nemocná, a místo toho si s rodinou užívá den plný zábavy. Gumball zrádce vystopuje, aby mu to vytmavil, ale když zjistí, že jeho máma je nemocná doopravdy, musí mu to nějak vynahradit."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E23 "Panu Smallovi připadá, že děti z Elmorské osmiletky dostatečně neinspiruje, a tak mu Gumball s Darwinem chtějí zvednout náladu. Aby měl pan Small pocit, že své žáky inspiroval, snaží se kluci řídit všemi jeho radami. Když však jeho neurčitá klišé vedou jen k tomu, že ve škole nadělají spoušť, musejí tu pohromu před ním zatajit, aby mu nedošlo, jak příšerné jeho rady byly."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E24 "Gumball se začne podivně zadrhávat a nechtěně tím urazí Darwina. Když ho Darwin požádá o radu s výběrem čepice, Gumball z ničeho nic nedokáže promluvit a Darwina se to dotkne. Je přesvědčený, že o něm Gumball řekl, že má tlustou hlavu. Když to chce Gumball uvést na pravou míru, začne mít potíže s řečí i pohyby. Brzy zjistí, že možná není jediný, kdo má v Elmore problémy s komunikací…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E22 Jamie si usmyslí, že potřebuje chlapce, a naneštěstí pro Darwina usoudí, že nejvhodnějším kandidátem je právě on. Když se Jamie nemá s kým podělit o oběd, uvědomí si, že potřebuje kluka. Darwin jako jediný okamžitě nevezme do zaječích, a tak chtě nechtě skončí spolu. Darwin si myslí, že nejlepší bude vše v tichosti přečkat, dokud se to jeho nové přítelkyni neomrzí. Ale neříct ani slovo je občas těžší, než se zdá.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E25 "Anais má novou kamarádku, ale Gumball s Darwinem pochybují, že jde o vztah rovnocenný. Při čtení Anaisina deníčku zjistí, že její vztah s novou kamarádkou se zdá poněkud jednostranný. Jodie snědla Anaisin oběd, shrábla zásluhy za její práci a přinutila ji nést jí batoh. Gumball si o ní myslí, že je parazit, a chce dokázat, že vymyla Anais mozek. Ale když obě dívky splynou do jednoho organismu, není snadné poznat, kdo že je parazit a kdo hostitel…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E26 "Obyvatelé města Elmore pátrají po smyslu lásky. Když Bobert zjistí, že ho napadl virus s názvem miluji_tě.exe, požádá Gumballa s Darwinem, aby mu vysvětlili význam slova "láska". Ti se mu ho pokusí vysvětlit pomocí písně, ale tím mu pochopení vůbec neusnadní. A tak poprosí ostatní obyvatele města Elmore, aby se podělili o vlastní pohled na to, co pro ně znamená láska."

programme.title: Totální Dramarama

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E33 "Wattersonovi se snaží Darwinovi připomenout jeho rybí kořeny. Když máma vidí, jak Darwin dlouze hledí do akvária, napadne ji, že životní styl savců jejího adoptivního syna nenaplňuje a v hloubi duše touží po návratu ke svým rybím kořenům. A tak se rodina pokusí obnovit jeho spojení s životem ve vodě. Zkusí rybí krmivo, rybí řeč a dokonce i rybí oblečení. Když nic z toho nezabere, uvědomí si, že ho možná budou muset nechat jít."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E34 "Sdružení rodičů a učitelů z Elmorské osmiletky zakáže videohry, a tak se děti snaží dokázat, že na ně videohry nemají špatný vliv. Gumball zasvětí Billyho do světa videoher, ale ten z čiré radosti omdlí. Jeho matka Felicity svolá sdružení a vyhrožuje, že zakáže videohry v celém Elmoru. Gumball s Darwinem dostanou tři příležitosti prokázat, že videohry mohou být užitečné, ale když neuspějí, rozhodnou se dokázat, že knihy mohou mít stejně zhoubný vliv."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E35 "Gumball se urazí, když ho Tobias nepoplácá po zadku jako všechny ostatní. Tobias ke každému plácnutí rukou přidá plácnutí přes zadek, takže když Gumballa vynechá, ten se cítí dotčen. Celý den se snaží, aby ho Tobias plácnul po zadku, ale když to nevyjde, usoudí, že aby se dočkal, musejí spolu strávit nějaký čas o samotě a vybudovat si dostatečně důvěrný vztah."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E36 "Anais ve svém pokojíku najde nepořádek jako po vloupání a zjistí, že její plyšák Daisy zmizel. Dojde jí, že hlavními podezřelými jsou Gumball s Darwinem. Jediná možnost, jak odhalit, co se stalo s Daisy, je zahájit důkladně vyšetřování. Postupně přichází záhadě na kloub a zdá se, že pachatelé kápnou božskou."

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Second Wave
programme.desc: The Taelons decide to leave Earth when it appears that the Jiridians are invading. Meanwhile, a group of Resistance prisoners saved from the mother ship include several disguised Jiridians who are causing trouble for Liam and Renee.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Essence
programme.desc: Renee's brother has PTSD. In a desperate effort to help him, she agrees to let him undergo special treatment. The treatment removes his emotion. The project is overseen by Sandoval and the emotion they take is given to Da'an.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Phantom Companion
programme.desc: While on board the mothership, Renee sustains an injury and while being treated, she gets pulled into the walls and disappears.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Dream Stalker
programme.desc: Street asks Liam to help a friend who's arrested for the murder of a man he hated. Liam talks to him and he claims that he dreamed of killing him.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Lost Generation
programme.desc: A CVI malfunctions and kills a soon-to-be father. The investigation leads Liam and Renee to a fertility clinic. Renee finds out she is infertile and suspects that Taelon technology is affecting worldwide fertility.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Summit
programme.desc: Da'an leaves and doesn't being Liam along. Zo'or is frantic as to why Da'an left. Liam wants to help but Zo'or doesn't trust him because he doesn't have a CVI, so Liam agrees to be implanted.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Dark Matter
programme.desc: When the mother ship hits dark matter, the ship dos not begin to heal itself. Zo'or is left in an unconscious state and Sandoval takes control. He decides it is time to liberate the Earth from the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Keys to the Kingdom
programme.desc: The relic left by Ma'el is stolen from the mother ship. Zo'or threatens to destroy a major city if it isn't returned. Liam believes the final chapters contain information on synthesizing core energy.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Street Chase
programme.desc: Sandoval is watching via nanobots inside Street as she tries to decipher Ma'el's riddle. She tries to figure out how to escape from Sandoval and the Taelons forcing her to solve the riddle. She flashes back to childhood fears.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Trapped by Time
programme.desc: Liam and Renee learn of a facility where time travelers from the future are being held. They try to learn from them what happens to the Taelons. Sandoval's wife is used as a pawn to gain important information from him.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Atonement
programme.desc: Sandoval goes to Renee to request a trial to testify to atrocities against humanity committed by the Taelons. A manhunt for Sandoval begins when he quits and leaves the mother ship. Liam has to protect him on his way to the grand jury.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Strange assaults and several deaths may be related to a Doors/Taelon joint venture where Taelon core energy was used to heal people. It appears that the energy is being sucked back out of the patients.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Hearts and Minds
programme.desc: When Renee's boyfriend appears to her while he is imprisoned on the mother ship, Liam theorizes a special energy bond between the pair. Zo'or is upset by the human's betrayal and bans all humans from the mother ship.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Epiphany
programme.desc: The Taelons announce that they will all go into death stasis and wait on the mother ship for humans to discover how to create core energy and revive them. Zo'or and Da'an don't trust each other to be the last to submit to stasis.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Dark Horizons
programme.desc: Eight Taelons are killed when protectors' implants are re-calibrated with a new imperative to kill instead of protect Taelons. They fear the Jiridians have found a way to control the CVIs. Meanwhile, their core energy continues to deplete.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Point of No Return
programme.desc: When Street solves the 8th dimension of Ma'el's riddle, a beacon leads Liam to a chamber with a healing pool. However, there is only enough in the healing pool to help 6 Taelons. Zo'or will do anything to insure his own life.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave
programme.desc: In 1978, one film changed the face of cinema forever. Long established as one of the most debated and divisive movies of all time, I Spit On Your Grave has been condemned by some as 'vile and depraved', whilst others hail it as a 'misunderstood masterpiece of cinema', 'the ultimate feminist movie'. Re-experience the phenomenon that shocked and divided the world, and influenced an entire genre and generation of film-makers, with Camille Keaton's portrayal of young writer Jennifer Hills, her horrific plans for revenge, and some of the most gruesomely, unforgettable scenes ever captured to film.

programme.title: Acts of Vengeance
programme.desc: A fast-talking lawyer transforms his body and takes a vow of silence, not to be broken until he finds out who killed his wife and daughter and has his revenge.

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including; Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: I Kill Giants
programme.desc: Barbara Thorson (Madison Wolfe) is a teenage girl who escapes the realities of school and a troubled family life by retreating into her magical world of fighting evil giants. With the help of her new friend Sophia (Sydney Wade) and her school counsellor (Zoe Saldana), Barbara learns to face her fears and battle the giants that threaten her world.

programme.title: Cold Brook
programme.desc: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns. Soon Ted and George learn that no one else can see the mysterious figure dressed in centuries-old clothing; his name is Gil Le Doux and he's searching for a way home.

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: For the Love of Benji
programme.desc: Benji is on holiday with his family in Greece, but after getting separated at the airport, he finds himself on another exciting adventure, now on the run from international spies!

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: 12 in a Box
programme.desc: 12 IN A BOX is the laugh-out-loud story of 12 former school friends who get together for a reunion they will never forget, where they are given the chance to win a life-changing 1million each. The only catch is, they cannot leave the estate for 96 hours, and anyone who enters the grounds must also stay for the duration! With time ticking away, the mismatched dozen are forced to work together to keep the peace and work toward their payday. But, when they have to deal with an untimely death, a kidnapping plot, another corpse, burglars, and then even a visit from the boys in blue, will this hapless clan be able to hold it together or will their dreams of riches be buried with the bodies? Staring Miranda Hart (Miranda, Call the Midwife) and Katy Wix (Not Going Out), this is classic British farce at its best.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: Call of The Wild
programme.desc: Call of The Wild is a modern-day story incorporating elements of Jack London's classic short novel. Whilst Ryann (Ariel Gade) is staying with her Grandpa Bill (Christopher Lloyd) a wild hybrid wolf/dog shows up injured on the back porch one night. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.desc: Tom Cruise steps into the spotlight, taking the lead in Risky Business, but when Paul Brickman is forced to change his ending will that put an end to Tom’s dreams?

programme.desc: Tom Cruise enters the danger zone as Tony Scott pushes the limits of the Navy and his actors to achieve his sun-kissed vision.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Tom Cruise
programme.desc: Having proved he’s a star, Tom now wanted to test himself as an actor. While remaining in the shadow of Dustin Hoffman’s performance in Rain Man, Tom is able to get his first Oscar nomination by breaking out of his mold in Born on the 4th of July.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Tom Cruise
programme.desc: Tom’s next two films will launch the careers of everyone around him while nearly delivering him that elusive Oscar. A Few Good Men is once again a win for Jack Nicholson rather than Tom, but Jerry Maguire brings him in reach of the Oscar.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Tom Cruise
programme.desc: Tom Cruise tests his limits, becoming a producer and taking on ever riskier stunts. But it’s his personal life that nearly sends his career spinning.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Tom Cruise

programme.desc: James ventures into Louisiana's state capital Baton Rouge on his American adventure to experience a unique American phenomenon - tailgating at a football match at Louisiana State University - and cook there ahead of the game.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Samuel West, Rishi Nair and Clarkson's Farm's Harriet Cowan join Alan. Elsewhere, there's the launch of a brand-new wildlife garden project, and Instagram and farming sensation Karl Franklin shows off his sheep herding skills. Plus, a catch-up with the East Sussex Wildlife Rescue Ambulance Service as they prepare to release some herring gulls back into the wild. Lager is the order of the day in today's Best of British.

programme.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
programme.desc: We're spending the weekend at Clodagh's home Broadspear with delicious cooking and easy eats with her husband Harry. After Clodagh throws open the windows early on Saturday morning, we join her to bake her simple Irish bread, the Clodagh Soda, collect eggs from her hens, then help Harry as he makes his signature amazing scrambled eggs for a great weekend breakfast. On Sunday, she's sharing her tips and tricks for making fresh homemade pasta to go with a simple roasted tomato sauce for the perfect Sunday supper in the garden.

programme.desc: The latest news and weather from the East of England. [S]

programme.title: New: Win Win with Postcode Lottery

programme.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
programme.desc: Joel Dommett and his mum Penny, Tony Bellew and his son Corey, and Vicky Pattison and her mum Carroll compete in the comedy game show where success lies in the hands of the parents - as Joel tries to overcome his second-place curse and Tony and Corey's bickering threatens to get the better of them, Vicky's past party lifestyle might just lead her and her mum to victory in a show with plenty of surprises that include Romesh's mum's method for getting away with murder.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot brings his journey to a close on the surf-battered shores of Strandhill, paddling out with Rebelle Surf into the cold Atlantic to understand why these waves draw people from across the world. He meets a couple who've eaten their way around the globe and landed here, bringing the bold, smoky flavours of the Basque country to the beach in Strandhill. Together they cook turbot over fire, a dish where Ireland and Spain meet to make something delicious. Then it's Dermot's turn. Joined by a host of faces he's met along the way, he takes everything he's seen and eaten along the series. He cooks a proper feast: fresh seafood, a deep, warming stew, and a fruit dessert that carries the sweetness of the whole journey. From the Causeway Coastal Route to the Wild Atlantic Way, it's a meal that tells the full story of the road behind him.

programme.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
programme.desc: We're spending the weekend at Clodagh's home Broadspear with delicious cooking and easy eats with her husband Harry. programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: It's a busy day on the farm as pigs head to the butcher, an injured hen gets expert care, and Kelvin enjoys time with the boys. Meanwhile, flooding threatens planting plans. [SL,S,AD]

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: James hits the East Coast of the great US of A with a visit to the historic city of Boston - his American adventure here starts with a shopping spree in the public market ahead of cooking with local ingredients. James also visits an innovative restaurant where cocktails are often inhaled rather than drunk and has some baked goods supplied by Joanne Chang, a Harvard graduate who has made a name for herself with a string of successful bakeries around the city - James's tour of the city wouldn't be complete without a trip to Fenway Park, the home of the Boston Red Sox, and a chance to live out a boyhood dream.

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: James cooks for two brilliant guests - TV sports presenter extraordinaire Clare Balding and rock royalty, the iconic Roger Taylor. Chefs Jose Pizarro and Meliz Berg join in the fun, cooking family favourite dishes.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: The legendary Eric Idle joins Alan, and La Voix makes her Love Your Weekend debut. We catch up with our puppy school to see how the class of '26 is getting on, herb grower Jekka McVicar has potions and spells this Halloween weekend, and we are celebrating the joy of Monty Python in today's Best of British, in honour of Eric Idle.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: On her morning rounds, Liz takes a moment to appreciate the life the family have built on the farm, but their peaceful routine is interrupted when calf Elizabeth develops a worrying wheeze. Fearing pneumonia, the illness that claimed beloved Cherry last year, Kelvin and Liz call in vet Hugo to investigate. Meanwhile, with the pigs gone, the family begin transforming the old pig field into a vegetable patch. Kelvin puts the tractor to work, but it soon breaks down, leaving the family to finish the job by hand. After hours of hard work, the field is transformed into a beautifully prepared bed, ready for leeks, cabbages, carrots and potatoes. With the Cheshire Show fast approaching, Marnie also completes her training with orphan lamb Hope. After weeks of practice, the pair are ready to take on the show ring, giving the family another exciting milestone in a busy farming year.

programme.title: Talking Royals

programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. Jane eventually escaped when Casey was 6 years old. Timothy Fast was arrested and incarcerated. Ever since, Jane has struggled to regain a normal life for her and her daughter. For Casey, the memories of a childhood in captivity still haunt her. Jane, on the other hand, has seemingly moved on. She has re-married and is happy. When a number of local women start to go missing, Jane reveals to Casey that Timothy might have had an accomplice and wonders if he is involved. The kidnapping M.O. is eerily similar. Casey is furious that her mother has hidden this knowledge from her all this time. Then, Jane suddenly disappears. Has she been kidnapped again? Casey must face the demons of her past in order to find her mother before it’s too late.

programme.title: Bakugan
programme.desc: In the exciting reboot of the BAKUGAN franchise, the VESTROIAN galaxy is made up of six planets each home to a different species of Bakugan.

programme.title: Blood Harvest
programme.desc: Hysteria, secrets, blame and judgement, it's time for a blood harvest. In an idyllic 1873 American Protestant village times are harsh and the grass is always greener on the other side. As the village suffers, one woman prospers and there are grumblings that she may be in league with the devil. Blood and secrets are shed and the cost of survival is revealed in this descent into the supernatural.

programme.title: Hangman
programme.desc: Returning from vacation, the Miller family find their home has been broken into. After cleaning up the mess they continue with their lives, shaking off the feeling of being violated. But little do they know the nightmare has just begun.

programme.title: The Triangle
programme.desc: In the summer of 2012, a group of four filmmakers receives a cryptic postcard from their friend, Nathaniel, who's been AWOL for more than three years. Despite the misgivings of one of the filmmakers, the group heads to Montana to answer Nathaniel's plea for help. With cameras rolling, the filmmakers set off to capture life inside what is either a harmless commune or something much more sinister

programme.title: Mythica: The Dragon Slayer
programme.desc: The end is here. Join sorceress Marek in the spectacular and gripping finale of the legendary Mythica journey. With a new evil to defeat, Marek embarks on an arduous quest to gain a valuable weapon from the Gods. From battling the Lich King's evil zombie legions to joining forces with her sworn enemy, will Marek save the Gods, the world and herself in time?

programme.title: Robin Hood: The Rebellion
programme.desc: The Raid meets Die Hard with a medieval twist, in this fast and furious new take on the legend of Robin Hood featuring the stars of Game of Thrones, Vikings and Torchwood. When Maid Marian is kidnapped by the Sheriff of Nottingham, Robin Hood must get a band of men together to save her. An audacious plan is set to penetrate the depths of the Sheriff’s castle to defeat the bloodthirsty tyrant.

programme.title: Rams
programme.desc: Inspired by the breakout Icelandic film and starring Sam Neill, Miranda Richardson and Michael Caton. Descended from their familys prized bloodline, estranged brothers Colin and Les work together but raise separate flocks of sheep. When Less prize ram is diagnosed with a rare illness, authorities order a purge of every sheep. Can the warring brothers set aside their differences and reunite?

programme.title: Pressure Point (PKA Heart of Champions)
programme.desc: Tough Army veteran, Coach Murphy (Shannon), arrives at the start of the new season to transform the status quo of a failing rowing team and unlock their true potential. With some tough love, can Coach Murphy inspire these young men to learn what it takes to be a team?

programme.title: The Adventures of Wolfboy
programme.desc: Starring Chlo Sevigny and Eve Hewson. In the vein of Little Miss Sunshine, with a modern day fairy-tale surrealism that fans of Tim Burton will love. This inspiring, precious drama follows a young boy's coming of age tale as he navigates life with "Wolfman Syndrome" a rare condition that causes abnormal hair growth. On his 13th birthday he goes in search of his mother who abandoned him at birth.

programme.title: The Ballad of Lefty Brown
programme.desc: Striving for justice, this non-stop, gun-toting western thriller stars Bill Pullman and Peter Fonda. Always the grizzled sidekick and never the hero, Lefty is pushed into the limelight when his best friend and longtime partner Edward is brutally murdered. In efforts to seek revenge, he is placed at odds with vested interests, hired guns, corrupt officials and his own abundant failings.

programme.title: All Nighter
programme.desc: Six months after a very awkward introductory dinner with his girlfriend Ginnie's dad - the tough and workaholic Mr Gallo - Martin, a talented but broke banjo musician, finds him knocking on his door looking for his daughter.

programme.title: Bad Match
programme.desc: Totally app-licable in the modern era of dating, this gripping, psychological thriller will have you thinking twice about your next swipe. It's all fun and games for Playboy Harris - he has it sussed when it comes to hooking up with new women. Little does he know, that his match with the obsessively twisted Riley is about to send his life into complete disarray. One to watch!

programme.title: Sniper Elite
programme.desc: Kevin Sorbo stars in this scorching sci-fi action film in which a squad of elite human soldiers faces down a powerful and deadly extraterrestrial army. When a top sniper from the World Defence Force, is trapped in enemy territory, his survival skills are put to the ultimate test as he takes on a battalion of Cerulean soldiers, hell bent on wiping all humans from existence.

programme.title: Redwood
programme.desc: Breakout film at Frightfest Festival and a must-watch for all horror fans! Josh and Beth visit a secluded national park for some quality time. Ignoring the advice of the Park Rangers, they venture off trail and come face to face with Redwood's legendary wildlife. A fresh spin to a well-worn mythology, creating an edge-of-your seat movie to shred your nerves and make you think twice about camping.

programme.title: Bloodthirsty
programme.desc: Frightfest Presents. Ambition can be killer. When an offer to work with one of the greatest music producers of all time comes along, singer Grey cant refuse but her new mentor isnt all that he seems to be. Moving to record her album in a remote location, Grey realises theres a beastly secret lurking. Will her humanity be the price for fame and how much blood will be shed to secure a hit?

programme.title: Bloodthirsty
programme.desc: Frightfest Presents. Ambition can be killer. When an offer to work with one of the greatest music producers of all time comes along, singer Grey cant refuse but her new mentor isnt all that he seems to be. Moving to record her album in a remote location, Grey realises theres a beastly secret lurking. Will her humanity be the price for fame and how much blood will be shed to secure a hit?

programme.title: The Bunker
programme.desc: This nighmareish horror will have you running towards the nearest exit. When Ella (Mischa Barton) discovers her Wall Street banker boyfriend is renting a secret storage unit, she becomes suspicious. Breaking in with her friend Molly (Emily Atack) they discover something sinister. Now trapped in the darkened building with a bunch of neurotic strangers, they must fight for their lives. Unmissable!

programme.title: Just Before I Go
programme.desc: Courteney Cox (Friends) directs this hysterical comedy drama starring Seann William Scott (American Pie) and Kate Walsh (The Perks of being a Wallflower). In an effort to move on, disgruntled 41-year-old divorcee Ted Morgan travels back to his hometown to face the people who have made him the man he is today. But little does he know, he has the chance to find new hope and love!

programme.title: Arthur and Merlin
programme.desc: A spectacular fantasy-epic, recounting the legendary adventures of two iconic characters. In Dark Ages Britain, a time of myth and magic, a Saxon force from the East attacks the Celtic people. However, hope is not lost when Arthur, a banished warrior, and Merlin, a hermit wizard, embark on a heroic quest to save their people. A mystic and mythical tale of courage and valour.

programme.title: LA Seduction
programme.desc: Stuck in a marriage to a rich movie producer, struggling actress Kathryn (Ashley Benson, Pretty Little Liars) finds herself attracted to her new gardener Ben (Shiloh Fernandez, Euphoria). She then meets eccentric millionaire Ed who's just moved in next door and a BBQ turns into a drunken party. Kathryn soon discovers that Ben and Ed have been hiding secrets and that her life is in grave danger.

programme.title: Spacewalker
programme.desc: From the acclaimed team behind Wanted and Apollo 18. March 1965. In the heat of the Cold War, the USA and the USSR fight for supremacy in space, with both superpowers competing to be the first to have a man walk in outer space. No price is too high and no risk too great. Prepare to step into the unknown with this fascinating look into space travel. This edge-of-your-seat thriller is one to watch!

programme.title: Reclaim
programme.desc: Starring Ryan Phillippe, Rachelle Lefevre and John Cusack. Steven and Shannon risk their lives to reveal the truth behind their newly adopted daughter's disappearance. They soon discover that all is not what it seems when they uncover a high-stakes underground child trafficking scam, which sends them on a high octane mission of retribution. How far will they go to save their daughter?

programme.title: The Resistance
programme.desc: Compassionate, harrowing and full of unexpected humour, this is the incredible telling of a largely unknown chapter of the Jewish resistance. While the Nazi regime celebrate the capital of the Reich free of Jews, they are unaware of a group who have escaped. Hidden in their various guises we follow the journey of four Jews as they survive, while hiding in plain sight of the enemy.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: Teenager Megan Walsh (Hailee Steinfeld, Enders Game) is a special ops agent who yearns for a normal adolescence. After faking her own death she assumes the role of an exchange student at a typical American high school, only to find that surviving here is harder than international espionage! Jam-packed with hilarious performances from Samuel L. Jackson, Jessica Alba and Sophie Turner.

programme.title: What Lies Below
programme.desc: A Quiet Place meets Species. Mena Suvari faces aquatic horrors in this tense, original and sexy sci-fi thriller. When Libby returns from summer camp she is introduced to her Mum's chiseled fianc, John. When John ignites an inappropriate curiosity in Libby her suspicions are escalated when she sees a piercing, amber light from the lake outside, and witnesses John submerge and disappear.

programme.title: Wolves of War
programme.desc: A fast-paced, action-packed war thriller based on true events. Decorated British officer Jack Wallace (Ed Westwick - Gossip Girl) must lead a band of Allied commandos across enemy lines to rescue an American scientist held hostage by the Nazis. With information that could turn the tide of war, these unlikely heroes must traverse enemy territory with an untrained US civilian to secure victory.

programme.title: The Hatton Garden Job
programme.desc: A remarkable true story of the largest heist in English legal history. Four ageing East End criminals led by 76 year-old Brian Reader (Larry Lamb) drill into a steel-and-concrete secured safety deposit vault in Londons Hatton Garden jewellery quarter. With everyone from the Hungarian mob to Scotland Yard on their tail, will they commit the crime of the century or pay with their lives?

programme.title: The Sinners
programme.desc: When a clique of seven students at a popular Catholic high school, led by the daughter of a local pastor, form a secret cult where each of them embody one of the deadly seven sins, their scandalous behaviour catches the attention of the local community. The group quickly realises that someone in their Christian town wants to teach the girls a deadly lesson as they start to go missing, one by one.

programme.title: Not Cinderella’s Type
programme.desc: Indy lives with her aunt and uncle and believes her life is fine until an accident brings a new guy into her life. Bryant Bailey is not Indy's type - she's never been into guys like him. But then again, she's never really known anyone so stubborn and caring that can also help her discover who she is and what she's worth. A modern telling of Cinderella, based on the novel by Jenni James.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.desc: An injured dancer and a shy deaf girl overcome bullies, disability stigma, and other high school obstacles, developing a beautiful friendship amidst original and licensed songs and stunning choreography.

programme.title: Love on Trend
programme.desc: When Allie left her small town to move to San Francisco to pursue her dream of becoming a fashion designer, little did she imagine that the city had big plans for her - and for her heart.

programme.title: Hometown Remedy
programme.desc: A busy surgeon heads back home to celebrate her father becoming mayor. But after a chance encounter with the town's only doctor-and most eligible bachelor-she witnesses true compassion which might be the prescription this doctor needs.

programme.title: Love Across Time
programme.desc: While inspecting an old British manor for its real estate potential, Chelsea discovers a portal through time that connects with the late 1700s owner of the property. When an accident occurs, the gentleman comes through and gets stuck in the present day.

programme.desc: When two childhood friends are reunited through a generous inheritance that bestows far more on their broken hearts than they bargained for - a second chance at love.

programme.title: Farm To Fork To Love
programme.desc: A young and talented chef, ALICE (Meggan Kaiser), works as a sous chef at one of the top restaurants in New York. After a disastrous night serving a food critic, she receives an invitation to judge a food competition in honor of the prestigious annual fundraiser for the St. Andrew’s Children’s Hospital. Alice accepts the invitation despite the dismay of BRETT, her boss who is also her boyfriend. Once she gets to Kansas, Alice is surprised to find her former boyfriend in college, CHRISTIAN (Scot cooper), is amongst the judges. The cooking show and her reconnection with Christian will make Alice reconsider her calling and make her dreams come true.

When he is too nervous to reveal his feelings, the campers put competition aside and rally together to help him win over her heart while building friendships that will last a lifetime.

programme.desc: A handsome stranger develops amnesia after a bibliophile crashes into him on her bicycle.

programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.desc: One woman’s personal mission to reduce her household rubbish turned into a passion that gave birth to Southeast Asia’s first Zero-Waste Bulk Food shop. Claire is a driven and successful mother of three who turned away from her corporate job to channel her business-savvy into reducing our impact on the environment and contributing to the improvement of her local community.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Zaira (Argentina)
programme.desc: For a long time Zaira let herself be defined solely as a survivor of the traumatic sexual assault that marked her life. In her healing search, she left behind the busy city life and moved to seek solace in the mountains of Mendoza. - It is among these magnificent peaks that Zaira found peace within herself and harmony with her surroundings. Now, eager to help others heal, she is the leader of a trekking initiative that doubles as a support group for other women who are victims of sexual aggression.

programme.title: My Zen People - 4 - Ile (Argentina)
programme.desc: Ileana studied business and worked long hours indoors for a multinational logistics company. Her love for dance and desire for movement drove her to quit her corporate life and begin a new chapter as a fitness trainer. Quickly exhausting the traditional methods available at her local gyms, she began to create innovative and groundbreaking exercise methods of her own. Her goal: to empower women by making them feel strong and feminine at the same time.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - The Country of Le Mans
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - Seashells on the menu
programme.desc: We will start this journey near La Rochelle to learn a little more about the breeding of the famous bouchot mussels but also a very particular technique to cook them. We will then go on a tour of France's best oysters: towards Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier and finally Oléron to learn about the different breeding methods and to find out more about all the species in France. Julie will cook a fricassee of berniques, the little Chinese hats that cover the rocks of the coast, as well as pink clams that are little known to the public. We will continue our journey in Finistère to meet Sylvain, the only abalone breeder in the country, and then to Méru where there are still workshops magnifying this sublime material. The Chef Jean-Marie Baudic will cook scallops like no one else.

In Italy, in Venice, on the verge of drowning, major development work, industrialisation and tourism have upset the environment. In New Caledonia, flying over the heart of Voh is surrounded by the largest lagoon in the world. 24,000 km2 protected by a coral reef.

programme.desc: David Jeannerot left the world of fashion and abandoned his career as artistic director to become a plant. An exceptional florist who wishes to give back all its place to nature in the city. - David had a dream life. He traveled around the world for major ready-to-wear brands. But under the appearance David was actually very isolated. To give meaning to his life, and to go in the direction of his personal convictions, he decides to become a plantist. He arranges corners of greenery on the smallest window sill with the aim of bringing nature to the city, and to make Paris greener.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Agostina (Argentina)
programme.desc: When Agostina’s mother was diagnosed with breast cancer, she began seeking out soft natural fabrics that would not irritate her mother’s sensitive skin. She found it almost impossible to find the right materials, so she decided to make her own. Research led her to bamboo fibers and she realised she could make a positive impact on the environment, while developing sustainable and ethical fashion.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Solenn (Nantes)
programme.desc: A former school teacher reinvents herself when she discovers a passion for sharing other women’s stories. Always inspired by the journeys of strong women, Solenn began a blog to celebrate the women in her community. - Solenn’s energy and passion fueled a dream of starting her own magazine. Thanks to a successful crowdfunding campaign, this dream blossomed into a professional career in journalism and she launched a print mook (magazine & book) called Etonnantes. Etonnantes features interviews of women of all backgrounds, celebrating their diversity and success in each field.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Sophie (Nantes)
programme.desc: Always an artist at heart, Sophie grew up in the countryside amongst nature and farm animals. Her love for creating art while respecting nature turned into a drive to seek out sustainable vegetable dyes. - Today, her artwork and craft are intertwined as she makes beautiful prints and motifs that she colours with natural dyes, prepared from handpicked variety of flowers and plants that turn into stunning creations.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - The Bordeaux country
programme.desc: Julie meets us in Bordeaux after having surveyed the Blaye region, visited the Basin twice and travelled through the Libourne region twice, it was necessary to stop in the capital of Bordeaux one day! Julie invites the inhabitants to discover the traditions but also the more recent projects of this city full of history and gastronomy.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - Poultry on the menu
programme.desc: Julie heads for Burgundy to discover ancient breeds of poultry reintroduced to France thanks to the work of breeder Fred Ménager. We'll then move on to Auvergne to discover how the famous Label Rouge is awarded and the role of certifying bodies ... because it's important to know what ends up on our plates. Julie also travels to the Drôme to cook guinea fowl, before heading to the Périgord to prepare a turkey stew. Julie will then head back up towards the center to discover an amazing fly maker who uses rooster feathers!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Andrew
programme.desc: For many years, Andrew was a successful American child-actor on the popular show My Wife and Kids, until he dropped everything and embarked on a journey to find life’s true meaning. He now lives in Bali where he coaches people from all over the world on how to radically transform their diets. His 360° transformative journey includes meditation, yoga and nutrition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. - Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - The mushroom route
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a mushroom tour. There is nothing better to occupy your weekends than a walk in the forest in search of edible mushrooms. Some species, such as the cep or the chanterelle, can be preserved very well in the freezer or, for the more patient, in jars. We will also meet two chefs who are passionate about mushrooms and have become specialists in the subject: Franck Quinton and Régis Marcon. But for the moment, we're on the road, discovering typically French dishes with astonishing button mushrooms in Touraine, morels in the Jura, ceps in Gironde, russules charbonnières in Normandy and coulemelles in Auvergne!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - 4 - Truffle flavors
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle. And along the way, we will twist the neck of some clichés. - Truffle hunting with dogs, with a sow but also flies... markets and of course cooking to discover or rediscover this mysterious mushroom, in all its aspects, in a salty but also sweet version... Richerenches, Carpentras, Saint Avère, Toulouse, Aix en Provence… the south of France will honor this black diamond!

programme.title: Earth from above - 1 - Everything is living and everything is linked - Part 1
programme.sub-title: Everything is living and everything is linked - Part 1
programme.desc: Through the most magnificent images and astonishing human stories, Man is at the heart of the biodiversity that he must respect and preserve. We find ourselves in Kenya, where the biodiversity is particularly rich, in the Massaï Mara reserve. Then, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the worrying disappearance of hippos from Lake Edward has unexpected consequences for the survival of fishermen. Then, in the sanctuary of life, the Pantanal region in Brazil, where millions of animal and plant species are teeming, some of the world's great wetlands also in danger. In Tasmania, Yann Arthus-Bertrand fights against the napalm deforestation of one of the oldest and most beautiful forests in the world.

programme.title: My Zen Trendy - 1 - Paddle Yoga
programme.desc: ValKahl tries out the addictive and zen yoga lesson on water on a paddleboard with YOGAqua, in Marina Del Rey. Along the way, she can’t resist biting a mustard plant, feeding and ‘french kissing’ Stanley, the celebrity giraffe. She later harvests some fresh organic vegetables in Saddle Rock Garden!
